steps: Bowl the cottage cheese.
Top berries and pistachios.
Cinnamon.

name: Herbed White Bean Dip with Crudités
steps: Blend beans, oil, lemon, garlic, rosemary, salt.
Top parsley and extra oil.
Serve with vegetables.

name: Mini Caprese Egg Bites
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, salt.
Divide tomato, mozzarella, basil into mini muffin cups; pour eggs.
Bake at 350°F 15–18 minutes.

name: Spiced Walnuts
steps: Toss walnuts with oil, spices, sweetener, salt.
Roast at 350°F 10–12 minutes.
Cool.

name: Smoked Trout Pâté with Cucumber
steps: Blend trout, cream cheese, yogurt, lemon, dill, pepper.
Slice cucumber.
Serve pâté on cucumber rounds with chives.

name: Cinnamon Apple Chips (Baked)
steps: Slice apples paper-thin; toss with cinnamon.
Bake on racks at 200°F 2 hours, flipping once.
Cool to crisp.

name: Turkey Pinwheels (Low-Carb Tortilla)

Dress with lemon, oil, salt.
Feta.

name: Thai Chicken Zoodle Salad
steps: Whisk peanut butter, lime, tamari, ginger, sriracha, water.
Toss zoodles, carrot, cabbage, chicken, cilantro with dressing.
Peanuts.

name: Avocado Shrimp Chopped Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp; cool.
Chop vegetables.
Toss with lemon, oil, dill, salt; add shrimp.

name: Lentil Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
steps: Whisk oil, balsamic, Dijon.
Toss lentils, diced beet, arugula with dressing.
Goat cheese, walnuts.

name: Turkey Cobb Lettuce Bowl
steps: Boil eggs; crisp bacon.
Mix yogurt, ranch seasoning, lemon.
Arrange over romaine; dressing.

name: Edamame Avocado Salad with Lime
steps: Combine edamame, avocado, cucumber, tomato, cilantro.
Dress with lime, sesame oil, tamari.
Sesame seeds.

name: Grilled Chicken & Peach Arugula Salad
steps: Grill chicken; slice. Grill peach halves 2 minutes.
Toss arugula with oil and balsamic.
Top chicken, peach, goat cheese, almonds, basil.

name: Chicken Vegetable Quinoa Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic in oil.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add zucchini and cooked quinoa 5 minutes; parsley.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup with White Beans
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with basil; stir in yogurt; salt.

name: Beef & Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown beef cubes in oil; add onion, carrot, celery, garlic.
Add broth, tomatoes, thyme, bay; simmer 60 minutes.
Add green beans and zucchini 8 minutes.

name: Zucchini Chicken Meatball Soup
steps: Mix chicken, egg, parmesan, almond flour, garlic; form small meatballs.
Sauté onion and carrot; add broth and seasoning; simmer; drop in meatballs 12 minutes.
Add zucchini and spinach 4 minutes.

name: Shrimp & Vegetable Miso Soup
steps: Simmer broth with ginger and mushrooms 5 minutes; add bok choy and tofu.
Add shrimp 3 minutes.
Whisk in miso off heat; green onion, sesame oil.

name: Lentil Kale Soup with Lemon
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, garlic, cumin in oil.
Add lentils and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Add kale 5 minutes; lemon, salt.

name: Turkey Taco Soup
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add seasoning.
Add beans, tomatoes, broth, corn, chiles; simmer 20 minutes.
Cheddar, yogurt, cilantro.

name: Cauliflower Curry Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder in oil.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes; blend.
Stir in coconut milk and chickpeas; lime, cilantro.

name: Chicken, Kale & White Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add broth and chicken; simmer 15 minutes; shred.
Add beans and kale 5 minutes.
Parmesan, pepper flakes, lemon.

name: Salmon Miso Soup Bowl
steps: Simmer broth with ginger and shiitake 5 minutes; add bok choy and rinsed shirataki.
Add salmon chunks 4 minutes.
Miso off heat; green onion.

name: Mexican Chicken Lime Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, jalapeño, cumin in oil.
Add broth, tomato, chicken; simmer 18 minutes; shred.
Lime juice, cilantro, avocado.

name: White Bean Rosemary Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, rosemary in oil.
Add beans and broth; simmer 15 minutes; blend half.
Lemon, parmesan, salt.

name: Roasted Garlic Chicken Thighs with Broccolini
steps: Rub chicken with oil, garlic, rosemary, salt; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Add broccolini tossed in oil and pepper flakes; roast 10 minutes more.
Squeeze lemon over everything.

name: Diner Veggie Omelet with Cheddar
steps: Sauté the pepper, mushrooms and onion in half the oil until soft; set aside.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and cook in the rest of the oil over medium heat.
When nearly set, add the vegetables and cheddar to one half and fold.
Slide onto a plate and serve hot.

name: Denver Scramble
steps: Dice the ham, pepper and onion.
Sauté them in oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Finish with pepper and chives.

name: Egg and Turkey Sausage Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Shape the sausage into two thin patties and brown 3 minutes a side.
Fry the eggs in the oil.
Toast the muffins.
Layer sausage, egg, cheddar and spinach in each muffin.

name: Huevos Rancheros Bowl
steps: Warm the beans with a third of the salsa.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set.
Spoon the beans into bowls and top with eggs.
Finish with the rest of the salsa, avocado, cotija and cilantro.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries and Pecans
steps: Stir the vanilla and cinnamon into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt and berries in two glasses.
Top with chopped pecans.

name: Blueberry Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk the oat flour, baking powder, eggs, yogurt and vanilla into a thick batter.
Fold in the blueberries.
Cook small pancakes in a buttered pan, 2 minutes a side.
Serve warm.

name: Almond Flour Waffles with Strawberries
steps: Whisk the almond flour, baking powder, eggs, yogurt and vanilla.
Cook in a greased waffle iron until golden.
Slice the strawberries.
Serve the waffles topped with berries.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Peaches
steps: Divide the cottage cheese between two bowls.
Top with sliced peach, almonds and hemp seeds.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Sweet Potato and Sausage Breakfast Hash
steps: Dice the sweet potato small and sauté in oil for 10 minutes.
Add the sausage, pepper and onion and cook 8 minutes.
Season with paprika and salt.
Make wells, crack in the eggs and cover until set.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Spread, top with egg and a pinch of pepper flakes.

name: Spinach and Feta Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and oil a 6-cup muffin tin.
Chop the spinach and pepper and divide among the cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and add the feta.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Southwest Tofu Scramble
steps: Crumble the tofu and sauté with the onion and pepper in oil.
Stir in turmeric and cumin.
Add the beans and heat through.
Serve with salsa.

name: Steel-Cut Oatmeal with Walnuts and Cinnamon Apples
steps: Simmer the oats in water with salt for 20 minutes.
Cook the diced apple with cinnamon in a splash of water until tender.
Spoon the oats into bowls and top with apples and walnuts.

name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Cucumber Bites
steps: Slice the cucumber into thick rounds.
Spread each with cream cheese.
Top with salmon, capers and dill.

name: Turkey Bacon and Egg Cups
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Line three muffin cups with turkey bacon.
Crack an egg into each and scatter with cheddar.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes and finish with chives.

name: Chia Pudding with Raspberries
steps: Stir the chia, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours, stirring once.
Top with raspberries.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Oat Bowl
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in half the banana, mashed.
Top with sliced banana and a spoon of peanut butter each.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Whisk the yogurt, lemon, garlic and mustard into a quick dressing.
Toss the shredded chicken and romaine with the dressing.
Spoon onto the tortillas, add parmesan and roll.

name: Tuna Salad Melt on Rye
steps: Mix the tuna, celery, chopped pickle, yogurt and mustard.
Pile onto the bread and top with cheddar.
Broil 3 minutes until the cheese melts.

name: Grilled Chicken Avocado Sandwich
steps: Pound the chicken thin, brush with oil and grill 4 minutes a side.
Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado and mustard.
Layer chicken, tomato and arugula.

name: Turkey Burger Lettuce Wrap
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, paprika and salt and shape three patties.
Grill or pan-sear 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Wrap each patty in lettuce with tomato, onion, pickle and mustard.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve the peppers and roast them cut-side up for 10 minutes at 400°F.
Slice the steak thin and sear with the onion and mushrooms in oil.
Fill the peppers, top with Swiss and bake 8 minutes.

name: Egg Salad on Ezekiel Toast
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and chop.
Fold in the yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Pile onto the toast and dust with paprika.

name: Pulled Chicken BBQ Sandwich
steps: Simmer the chicken in broth-free water until cooked, then shred.
Whisk the tomato paste, vinegar, paprika, garlic and sweetener into a sauce.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and warm through.
Pile onto toasted muffins with coleslaw mix.

name: Reuben Roll-Ups
steps: Lay out the turkey slices and spread with mustard.
Add Swiss, sauerkraut and a pickle spear.
Roll tight and sear seam-side down for 2 minutes.

name: Hummus and Veggie Pita Pocket
steps: Halve the pitas and open the pockets.
Spread with hummus.
Stuff with cucumber, tomato, greens, onion and feta.

name: California Turkey Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with mashed avocado and mustard.
Layer turkey, spinach and tomato.
Sprinkle with seeds, roll and halve.

name: Sloppy Joe Stuffed Sweet Potato
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes at 400°F until tender, about 35 minutes.
Brown the turkey with onion and pepper.
Add tomato sauce, mustard, vinegar and chili powder and simmer 10 minutes.
Split the potatoes and spoon the filling over.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken with Green Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken with oil, lemon, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Roast on a tray with the green beans for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Chili
steps: Put the chicken, beans, chiles, onion, garlic, spices and broth in the slow cooker.
Cook on low for 4 hours.
Shred the chicken, stir back in and finish with lime juice.

name: Chicken Pot Pie Soup
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and celery in oil.
Add the broth, cauliflower and chicken and simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add peas, cream and thyme and heat through.

name: Chicken Fajita Skillet
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
Toss the chicken in taco seasoning and sear in oil for 6 minutes.
Add the vegetables and cook until charred at the edges.
Finish with lime and serve with warm tortillas and avocado.

name: Turkey Meatloaf with Tomato Glaze
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the turkey, egg, oat bran, onion, garlic, salt and pepper.
Press into a loaf pan.
Stir the tomato paste with vinegar and spread over the top.
Bake 50 minutes.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Sear the sliced chicken in oil, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger 4 minutes.
Return the chicken with soy sauce and sesame oil and serve over rice.

name: Buffalo Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes until tender, about 45 minutes.
Shred the chicken and toss with hot sauce and yogurt.
Split the potatoes and fill with the chicken.
Top with celery, green onion and blue cheese.

name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Rub the chicken with oil, garlic, seasoning and salt.
Roast 25 minutes with the broccolini.
Scatter parmesan on top for the last 5 minutes.

name: Ground Turkey Taco Skillet with Beans and Corn
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in oil.
Stir in the taco seasoning, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Top with cheddar and cilantro.

name: Chicken Parmesan with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan.
Sear in oil 3 minutes a side.
Top with marinara and mozzarella and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Warm the zucchini noodles briefly and serve alongside.

name: One-Pan Chicken Sausage and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss everything on a tray.
Roast 25 minutes, stirring once.
Splash with balsamic to finish.

name: Honey Mustard Chicken (No Added Sugar)
steps: Stir the mustard, yogurt, vinegar and spices.
Coat the chicken and roast at 400°F for 22 minutes.
Roast the asparagus in the oil alongside for the last 10 minutes.

name: Classic Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
steps: Sear the beef in oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onion, tomato paste, broth, thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and braise at 300°F for 2 hours.
Add the carrot, turnip and celery and cook 1 hour more until tender.

name: Bison Burger with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Mix the bison with onion, mustard and salt and shape four patties.
Roast the zucchini and pepper in oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Grill the patties 4 minutes a side.
Serve on romaine with tomato and the roasted vegetables.

name: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Slice the steak thin against the grain.
Sear in oil, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger 4 minutes.
Add the steak and coconut aminos and serve over cauliflower rice with sesame oil.

name: Steak Fajita Bowls
steps: Season and sear the steak, rest and slice.
Sauté the peppers and onion in oil.
Warm the beans and cauliflower rice.
Build the bowls and finish with avocado and lime.

name: Pork Chops with Apple and Sauteed Cabbage
steps: Season the chops and sear 4 minutes a side; set aside.
Sauté the onion, cabbage and apple in the same pan.
Stir in the vinegar, mustard and thyme.
Return the chops and finish in a 375°F oven for 8 minutes.

name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork (Low Sugar BBQ)
steps: Rub the pork with paprika, garlic, onion powder and salt.
Whisk the tomato paste, vinegar, sweetener and water and pour over.
Cook on low 8 hours.
Shred and toss in the juices.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves until pliable.
Mix the beef, cooked rice, onion, garlic, parsley and salt.
Roll the filling in the leaves and pack into a baking dish.
Cover with tomato sauce and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

name: Sheet Pan Steak and Asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F.
Rub the steak with oil, garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast on a tray with the asparagus and tomatoes for 12 to 15 minutes.
Rest and slice.

name: Beef Chili with Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin and tomato paste.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 40 minutes.

name: Korean-Style Beef Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the beef with garlic and ginger.
Stir in gochujang and coconut aminos.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with green onion, cucumber and sesame.

name: Sheet-Pan Dill Salmon and Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Place the salmon and broccoli on a tray and drizzle with oil.
Add garlic, lemon slices and salt.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes and finish with dill.

name: Shrimp Scampi with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Sauté the garlic in butter and oil.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes a side.
Add wine and lemon and reduce briefly.
Toss with the zucchini noodles and parsley.

name: Cajun Shrimp and Cauliflower Grits Bowl
steps: Simmer the cauliflower rice with milk until creamy, then stir in cheddar.
Toss the shrimp in Cajun seasoning and sear in oil.
Add the pepper and cook 3 minutes.
Spoon over the cauliflower base and top with green onion.

name: Tuna Patties with Lemon Yogurt Sauce
steps: Mix the tuna, egg, almond flour, celery, green onion and mustard and form patties.
Pan-fry in oil 3 to 4 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt with lemon juice and serve on the side.

name: Blackened Catfish with Collard Greens
steps: Sauté the bacon, onion and garlic, then the collards with vinegar and a splash of water until tender.
Coat the catfish in Cajun seasoning.
Sear in oil 4 minutes a side.
Serve on the greens.

name: Lemon Pepper Tilapia with Green Beans
steps: Season the tilapia with pepper, garlic powder and salt.
Pan-sear in half the oil, 3 minutes a side.
Sauté the beans in the remaining oil.
Finish both with lemon juice.

name: Crab Cakes with Greek Yogurt Remoulade
steps: Mix the crab, egg, almond flour, celery, Old Bay and mustard gently and form cakes.
Chill 15 minutes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt, lemon and chopped pickle for the sauce.

name: Salmon Patty Lettuce Wraps with Avocado
steps: Chop the salmon finely and mix with egg, oat bran, mustard, dill and lemon.
Shape four patties and chill.
Grill 4 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce with tomato and avocado.

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup (Chickpea Pasta)
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables, garlic and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Remove and shred the chicken.
Cook the pasta in the soup for 6 to 8 minutes.
Return the chicken and finish with parsley.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the broccoli and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend partly smooth, stir in the milk and mustard.
Melt in the cheddar off the heat.

name: Minestrone with White Beans
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Add zucchini and kale for the last 8 minutes.
Serve with grated parmesan.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup with Basil
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth, stir in cream and basil.

name: Turkey and Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in oil.
Add the broth, vegetables, tomatoes and seasoning.
Simmer 25 minutes.

name: Smoky Black Bean Soup with Lime Yogurt
steps: Sauté the onion, pepper and garlic in oil with cumin.
Add the beans and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half for body.
Serve with a spoon of yogurt, lime and cilantro.

name: Beef and Barley Stew
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, tomato paste, broth and thyme and simmer 1 hour.
Add the barley, carrot and celery and cook 30 minutes more.

name: Old-Fashioned Split Pea and Ham Soup
steps: Combine everything in a pot.
Simmer 70 minutes, stirring, until the peas collapse.
Remove the bay leaf and season with pepper.

name: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and brush the caps with oil.
Mix the wilted spinach, ricotta, garlic and sun-dried tomato.
Fill the caps and top with mozzarella.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Vegetarian Black Bean Burgers
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg, onion and spices and shape four patties.
Pan-fry in oil 5 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce with tomato and avocado.

name: Eggplant Parmesan Stacks
steps: Slice the eggplant and dip in egg, then almond flour.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F until golden, 20 minutes.
Stack with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 12 minutes more and finish with basil and parmesan.

name: Cauliflower Mac and Cheese
ing: Whole wheat pasta, cooked al dente
steps: Boil the pasta and cauliflower florets together until tender; drain.
Warm the milk, cream cheese, mustard and paprika.
Melt in the cheddar.
Fold in the pasta and cauliflower and bake 10 minutes at 400°F.

name: Lentil Sloppy Joes
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Simmer the lentils in the broth until tender, 20 minutes.
Sauté the onion and pepper and add the sauce, paste, mustard, vinegar and chili.
Combine and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon over toasted muffins.

name: Chopped Italian-Style Salad with Chickpeas
steps: Chop the romaine, cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Add the chickpeas, mozzarella and olives.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and seasoning and toss through.

name: Cobb Salad
steps: Grill and slice the chicken; hard-boil and slice the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange the romaine on a platter with rows of each topping.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard and drizzle.

name: Wedge Salad with Yogurt Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Cut the iceberg into wedges.
Blend the yogurt, blue cheese and lemon into a dressing.
Top with tomatoes, crisp bacon and onion.

name: Apple Walnut Chicken Salad
steps: Shred the chicken and dice the apple and celery.
Mix with yogurt, lemon and mustard.
Fold in the walnuts and serve on the greens.

name: Taco Salad with Ground Turkey
steps: Brown the turkey in oil with taco seasoning.
Arrange the romaine, beans and tomato in bowls.
Add the turkey, cheddar and avocado.
Top with salsa mixed with yogurt.

name: Spinach Salad with Warm Bacon Dressing
steps: Crisp the bacon and keep a spoonful of fat.
Whisk in vinegar, mustard and oil for a warm dressing.
Toss with the spinach, mushrooms and onion.
Top with sliced boiled egg and bacon.

name: West Coast Shrimp Louie Salad
steps: Poach the shrimp 3 minutes and cool.
Arrange the romaine, avocado, tomatoes and sliced eggs.
Stir the yogurt, tomato paste and lemon for a pink dressing.
Top with shrimp.

name: Southwest Chicken Chopped Salad
steps: Season the chicken with chili powder and cumin and grill; slice.
Chop the romaine and combine with corn, beans, tomatoes and avocado.
Whisk the lime juice and oil and toss with the chicken and cilantro.

name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites with Yogurt Dill Dip
steps: Toss the florets with almond flour, oil and garlic powder and roast at 450°F for 20 minutes.
Toss with hot sauce.
Stir the yogurt with dill and serve with celery sticks.

name: Deviled Eggs with Paprika
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Mash the yolks with yogurt, mustard and salt.
Pipe or spoon back into the whites.
Dust with paprika and chives.

name: Guacamole with Veggie Dippers
steps: Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt.
Fold in the onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeno.
Serve with cucumber and pepper strips.

name: Baked Zucchini Chips
steps: Slice the zucchini thin.
Dip in egg, then a mix of parmesan, almond flour and garlic powder.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: Chicken Salad Cucumber Cups
steps: Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a shallow well.
Mix the chicken, yogurt, celery, mustard and dill.
Fill the cups.

name: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Veggies
steps: Chop the artichokes and wilt the spinach.
Stir with yogurt, cream cheese, parmesan and garlic.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.
Serve with carrot and celery sticks.

name: Turkey Pepperoni Pizza Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and remove the portobello stems.
Spoon marinara into each cap.
Top with mozzarella and sliced sausage.
Bake 15 minutes.

name: Roasted Chickpea Snack Mix
steps: Pat the chickpeas dry.
Toss with the oil and spices.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes, adding nuts and seeds for the last 5.

name: Pepper Jack Stuffed Jalapeno Poppers
steps: Halve and seed the jalapenos.
Mix the cream cheese, pepper jack and garlic powder and fill.
Wrap in a strip of bacon if you like.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter and Cinnamon
steps: Slice the apple.
Serve with peanut butter and a dusting of cinnamon.

name: French Toast with Cinnamon and Berries
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip the bread slices until soaked through.
Brown in butter, 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Serve topped with berries.

name: Egg in a Hole
steps: Cut a round hole in each slice of bread.
Butter the pan and toast the bread on one side.
Flip, crack an egg into each hole and cook until set.
Season with pepper.

name: Bagel with Cream Cheese and Lox
steps: Split and toast the bagel.
Spread with cream cheese.
Top with salmon, tomato, red onion, capers and dill.

name: Bacon, Egg and Cheese Bagel Sandwich
steps: Crisp the bacon.
Fry the eggs.
Toast the bagel.
Layer bacon, egg, cheddar and spinach and close.

name: Shrimp and Grits
steps: Cook the grits in water until creamy and stir in the cheddar.
Crisp the chopped bacon and keep a spoonful of fat.
Sauté the pepper and garlic in the fat, add the seasoned shrimp and cook 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon and green onion over the grits.

name: Cheese Grits with a Fried Egg
steps: Cook the grits in water until thick.
Stir in cheddar and pepper.
Fry the eggs in butter.
Top the grits with an egg and chives.

name: Breakfast Hash with Potatoes and Peppers
steps: Dice the cooked potatoes small.
Brown the sausage with the onion and pepper in oil.
Add the potatoes and paprika and crisp 8 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs and cover until set.

name: Diner Home Fries with Eggs
steps: Dice the potatoes and onion.
Pan-fry in oil with paprika and salt until crisp, about 15 minutes.
Fry or scramble the eggs.
Serve together with parsley.

name: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Scramble the eggs with the spinach.
Fill half of each tortilla with eggs and cheddar and fold.
Crisp in a pan with oil, 2 minutes a side.
Serve with salsa.

name: Ham and Cheese Western Omelet
steps: Dice the ham, pepper and onion and sauté in half the butter.
Cook the beaten eggs in the rest of the butter.
Add the filling and Swiss and fold.

name: Cheesy Potato and Egg Breakfast Skillet
steps: Crisp the bacon in a skillet and set aside.
Brown the diced potatoes in oil.
Pour in the beaten eggs and cook gently.
Top with cheddar, bacon and green onion and cover to melt.

name: Peanut Butter and Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana and cinnamon.

name: Biscuit-Style Egg Muffin with Sausage
steps: Shape the sausage into four thin patties and brown.
Fry the eggs in butter.
Toast the bread.
Stack sausage, egg and cheddar between slices.

name: Hash Brown-Style Potato Cakes
steps: Grate the cooked potato and onion.
Mix with the egg and seasoning.
Shape into patties.
Pan-fry in oil until golden, 5 minutes a side.

name: Cinnamon Oatmeal with Peanut Butter
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in peanut butter and cinnamon.
Top with diced apple.

name: Greek Yogurt with Walnuts and Honey Drizzle
steps: Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with walnuts and a thin drizzle of honey.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Turkey Bacon, Egg and Tomato Breakfast Wrap
steps: Crisp the turkey bacon.
Scramble the eggs.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, bacon, tomato, spinach and cheddar.
Roll and halve.

name: Classic Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice.
Assemble with cheddar between, butter sides out.
Grill in a pan until golden, 3 to 4 minutes a side.

name: Turkey, Bacon and Avocado Club Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with mayo.
Layer turkey, bacon, avocado, tomato and romaine.
Cut into triangles.

name: BLT Sandwich with Avocado
steps: Cook the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayo and mashed avocado.
Layer bacon, tomato and romaine.

name: Cheeseburger on a Bun
steps: Shape the beef into four patties and season with salt.
Grill or pan-sear 4 minutes a side; add cheddar for the last minute.
Toast the buns.
Build with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle and mustard.

name: Turkey Burger on a Whole Bun with Avocado
steps: Mix the turkey with paprika and salt and shape four patties.
Pan-sear 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Toast the buns.
Build with avocado, tomato, lettuce and onion.

name: Patty Melt
steps: Caramelise the onion slowly in oil.
Form two oval patties and sear.
Layer patty, onion and Swiss between buttered bread.
Grill until crisp and melted.

name: Hot Dog with Sauerkraut and Mustard
steps: Grill or pan-sear the sausages.
Warm the buns.
Fill with sausage, sauerkraut, mustard and onion.

name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with celery, yogurt, mayo, mustard and lemon.
Pile onto bread with lettuce.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich on White
steps: Flake the tuna and mix with celery, chopped pickle and mayo.
Spread on bread with lettuce.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwich
steps: Slice the steak very thin.
Sauté the onion, pepper and mushrooms in oil.
Sear the steak, combine and top with Swiss to melt.
Pile into toasted buns.

name: Meatball Sub
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan, seasoning and garlic and shape twelve meatballs.
Brown, then simmer in the marinara for 15 minutes.
Fill the buns, top with mozzarella and broil briefly.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich with Slaw
steps: Use cooked, shredded pork shoulder.
Toss with the paste, vinegar, paprika and sweetener and warm.
Mix the slaw with the yogurt.
Pile pork and slaw into the buns.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
steps: Sauté the pepper and onion in oil.
Fill half of each tortilla with chicken, vegetables and pepper jack and fold.
Crisp 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Serve with salsa.

name: Steak and Bean Burrito
steps: Season and sear the steak; slice.
Warm the beans and rice.
Fill each tortilla with steak, rice, beans, cheddar and salsa.
Roll tight and serve with avocado and lime.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Season the chicken and sear in oil, then slice.
Build bowls from rice, beans, corn and romaine.
Top with chicken, pico and avocado, with lime.

name: Turkey and Swiss on White with Mustard
steps: Spread the bread with mustard.
Layer turkey, Swiss, tomato and lettuce.

name: Ham and Cheddar Sandwich
steps: Spread the bread with mustard.
Layer ham, cheddar, tomato and lettuce.

name: Classic Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Cook the pasta al dente and drain.
Warm the milk with butter and mustard.
Melt in the cheddar until smooth.
Fold in the pasta and finish with paprika.

name: Baked Ziti with Turkey Sausage
steps: Cook the pasta slightly under al dente.
Brown the sausage with garlic and stir in the marinara.
Mix the pasta, sauce and ricotta in a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
steps: Brown the beef with onion and garlic in oil.
Add the marinara and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and toss with the sauce.
Serve with parmesan.

name: Spaghetti and Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan, garlic and seasoning and shape meatballs.
Brown them, then simmer in the marinara for 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti.
Serve topped with meatballs, sauce and parsley.

name: Chicken Alfredo with Broccoli
steps: Sear the sliced chicken in butter and set aside.
Simmer the garlic and cream, then stir in the parmesan.
Cook the pasta with the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Toss everything together with pepper.

name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook the noodles al dente.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms in butter, add the milk and cheddar and stir until smooth.
Fold in the noodles, tuna and peas.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Beef Stroganoff over Egg Noodles
steps: Sear the sliced steak in oil and set aside.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms, add broth and mustard and reduce.
Stir in the sour cream and return the beef.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Chicken and Noodles
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Add the noodles to the broth and cook until tender.
Return the chicken and finish with parsley.

name: Chili Mac
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add chili powder, cumin, tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the cooked macaroni.
Top with cheddar.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Use cold, cooked rice.
Sear the diced chicken in oil, add garlic, carrot and peas.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then mix in the rice.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and finish with green onion.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Sear the shrimp in oil, 2 minutes, and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas, scramble in the eggs.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fold in the shrimp and green onion.

name: Jambalaya
steps: Brown the sausage and chicken in oil.
Add the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and cook until soft.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth and Cajun seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the rice and shrimp and cook until the rice is tender.

name: Red Beans and Rice
steps: Brown the sausage, then the onion, celery, pepper and garlic.
Add the beans, broth and seasoning and simmer 40 minutes, mashing some beans.
Serve over the rice.

name: Chicken and Rice Casserole
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil.
Mix the cooked rice, broccoli, onion, broth and garlic powder in a dish.
Top with the chicken and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Spanish Rice with Ground Turkey
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Stir in the spices and tomato sauce.
Fold in the cooked rice and simmer 8 minutes.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Mix the shredded chicken with onion and beans.
Dip the tortillas in warm enchilada sauce, fill and roll.
Pack seam-down in a dish, cover with sauce and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes and add cilantro.

name: Beef Tacos with Corn Tortillas
steps: Brown the beef with the taco seasoning.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheddar and salsa.
Top with sour cream.

name: Loaded Nachos with Beans and Chicken
steps: Spread the chips on a tray.
Top with chicken, beans and cheddar.
Bake at 400°F for 8 minutes until melted.
Finish with pico, guacamole, jalapeno and sour cream.

name: Shepherd's Pie with Mashed Potato Topping
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and carrot; stir in paste, broth, thyme and peas.
Mash the potatoes with milk and butter.
Spread the beef in a dish and cover with the mash.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Meatloaf Dinner with Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Mix the beef, egg, oat bran, onion and salt; press into a loaf pan, spread with paste and bake at 375°F for 50 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with milk and butter.
Steam the beans.
Serve slices with the sides.

name: Fish and Chips (Oven-Baked)
steps: Bake the fries according to the package.
Dip the cod in egg, then almond flour mixed with Old Bay.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Stir the yogurt with chopped pickle and lemon for a tartar sauce.

name: Southern Salmon Croquettes with Lemon Dill Yogurt
steps: Mix the salmon, egg, crumbed bread, celery, onion and mustard.
Shape into patties and pan-fry in oil 4 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt with lemon and dill and serve alongside.

name: Chicken Pot Pie Skillet
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and celery in butter.
Add the chicken, potatoes, broth and thyme and simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in the milk and peas and thicken by simmering.

name: Baked Chicken Thighs with Roasted Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken and potatoes with oil, garlic, rosemary, paprika and salt.
Roast 40 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 15.

name: Sausage and Peppers over White Rice
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the pepper and onion and cook until soft.
Stir in the marinara and seasoning and simmer 8 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Beef and Broccoli over White Rice
steps: Sear the sliced steak in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger.
Return the steak with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve over the rice.

name: Teriyaki-Style Chicken Bowls
steps: Sear the chicken pieces in oil.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce and vinegar and cook until glazed.
Steam the broccoli and carrot.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds.

name: Southern Baked Chicken Legs with Rice
steps: Rub the chicken with oil and the spices.
Roast at 425°F for 40 minutes.
Sauté the collards briefly.
Serve with the rice.

name: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic with the bacon.
Add the potatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash partly, stir in the milk and half the cheddar.
Top with sour cream, green onion and the rest of the cheddar.

name: Corn Chowder
steps: Crisp the bacon, then soften the onion and celery.
Add the corn, potatoes, broth and thyme and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend a third of the soup and stir back in with the milk.

name: Chicken and Rice Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot, celery, onion and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Add the cooked rice and heat through; finish with parsley.

name: Hearty Beef and Potato Stew
steps: Brown the cubed beef.
Add the onion, paste, broth, thyme and bay leaf and simmer 1 hour.
Add the potatoes, carrots and celery and cook 30 minutes more.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup with Egg Noodles
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Cook the noodles in the soup 6 minutes and return the chicken.

name: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese Dippers
steps: Simmer the tomatoes, broth, onion and garlic 15 minutes, blend and stir in the milk.
Make small grilled cheese sandwiches in butter and cut into strips.
Serve for dipping.

name: Vegetable Beef Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add everything else and simmer 35 minutes.

name: White Bean and Ham Soup
steps: Combine everything in a pot.
Simmer 35 minutes, mashing some beans for body.
Remove the bay leaf.

name: Italian Sub Salad
steps: Chop the romaine, tomato and onion.
Add sliced meats, mozzarella and olives.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and seasoning and toss.

name: Chef Salad
steps: Arrange the romaine, cucumber and tomato.
Add rows of turkey, ham, sliced egg and Swiss.
Whisk the oil, mustard and vinegar and drizzle.

name: Greek-Style Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta and cool under water.
Toss with cucumber, tomatoes, onion and olives.
Dress with oil, vinegar and oregano and add feta.

name: Barbecue Chicken Salad
steps: Grill the chicken with a rub of paste, vinegar and paprika; slice.
Toss the romaine, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Top with chicken and avocado and drizzle with thinned yogurt.

name: Loaded Potato Skins with Bacon and Cheddar
steps: Bake the potatoes, halve and scoop out most of the flesh.
Brush the skins with oil and crisp for 10 minutes at 425°F.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and melt.
Top with yogurt and green onion.

name: Chips with Fresh Salsa and Guacamole
steps: Serve the chips with pico de gallo and guacamole.

name: Turkey and Cheese Roll-Ups
steps: Spread the turkey with mustard.
Add Swiss, pickle and lettuce.
Roll tight and slice.

name: Baked Pepper Jack Quesadilla Wedges
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with pepper jack and chiles.
Fold and crisp in a pan.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Bagel Chips with Hummus
steps: Slice the bagel thin, brush with oil and garlic powder.
Bake at 375°F for 10 to 12 minutes.
Serve with hummus and cucumber.

name: Cheese and Fruit Snack Plate
steps: Slice the cheeses and apple.
Arrange with the almonds and crackers.

name: Smothered Pork Chops with Rice
steps: Season the chops and sear in oil.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the pan, add broth and milk and simmer to a gravy.
Return the chops and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Oven BBQ Chicken Thighs with Slaw and Beans
steps: Whisk the paste, vinegar, paprika, garlic powder and sweetener into a sauce.
Coat the chicken and roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.
Toss the slaw with the yogurt.
Serve with warmed beans.

name: Slow Cooker Beef Chili with Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Put everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours.

name: Chili Cheese Baked Potato
steps: Bake the potatoes until tender.
Brown the beef with onion and chili powder; add tomatoes and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Split the potatoes and top with chili and cheddar.

name: Turkey Chili Dogs
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the ground turkey with the onion and chili powder; add the sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Grill the sausages.
Serve in buns with the chili and cheddar.

name: Cheese Pizza-Style Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas on a tray at 425°F for 3 minutes.
Spread with marinara, mozzarella and seasoning.
Bake 8 minutes and finish with basil.

name: Pepperoni-Style Turkey Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas.
Top with marinara, mozzarella, sliced sausage, pepper and onion.
Bake at 425°F for 8 minutes.

name: Gumbo with Chicken and Sausage
steps: Brown the chicken and sausage in oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in the same pot.
Add the broth, tomatoes, okra, seasoning and meats and simmer 35 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Seafood Gumbo with Shrimp and Crab
steps: Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in oil.
Add the broth, tomatoes, okra and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the shrimp and crab for the last 5 minutes.

name: Crawfish-Style Shrimp Étouffée
steps: Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in butter.
Stir in the paste, broth and seasoning and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 4 minutes.
Serve over rice with green onion.

name: Blackened Chicken with Dirty Cauliflower Rice
steps: Coat the chicken in Cajun seasoning and sear in oil, 5 minutes a side.
Brown the turkey with the onion, pepper and celery and add the cauliflower rice.
Serve the sliced chicken over the rice with green onion.

name: Louisiana Red Rice with Smoked Sausage
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in oil.
Add the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and soften.
Stir in the paste, broth and seasoning, then the cooked rice, and heat through.

name: Hoppin' John with Black-Eyed Peas
steps: Simmer the peas with the ham, onion, celery, pepper, garlic and broth for 30 minutes.
Serve over the rice with hot sauce.

name: Smothered Chicken Thighs with Onion Gravy
steps: Season and sear the chicken in oil, then set aside.
Cook the onions slowly in the pan until deep golden.
Add the broth, thyme and arrowroot slurry and simmer to a gravy.
Return the chicken and braise 20 minutes; serve with green beans.

name: Southern Pan-Fried Catfish with Slaw
steps: Dip the catfish in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan and seasoning.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes a side.
Toss the slaw with yogurt and vinegar and serve alongside.

name: Shrimp Po' Boy Lettuce Boats
steps: Season the shrimp and sear in oil 2 minutes a side.
Mix the mayo, hot sauce and lemon.
Fill the lettuce leaves with shrimp, tomato, pickle and sauce.

name: Oyster Po' Boy on a Bun
steps: Dip the oysters in egg, then almond flour and seasoning.
Pan-fry in oil until golden, about 2 minutes a side.
Toast the buns and fill with oysters, lettuce, tomato and mayo.

name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
steps: Sear the seasoned chicken in oil and slice.
Soften the pepper, mushrooms and garlic.
Add the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and chicken.

name: Creole Shrimp and Okra Stew
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the okra, tomatoes and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp and cook 4 minutes.

name: Southern Cabbage and Sausage Skillet
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in oil.
Add the onion and garlic, then the cabbage and broth.
Cook covered 15 minutes and finish with vinegar.

name: Black-Eyed Pea Salad (Texas Caviar)
steps: Combine the peas, corn, pepper, onion and jalapeno.
Dress with vinegar, oil and lime and fold in cilantro.
Chill an hour before serving.

name: Southern Chicken Salad with Pecans and Apple
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with celery, apple and pecans.
Bind with yogurt, mayo, mustard and lemon.
Serve over the greens.

name: Pimento-Style Cheese Celery Boats
steps: Mix the grated cheddar, cream cheese, chopped red pepper, mayo and seasoning.
Fill celery stalks.

name: Low-Country Boil
steps: Bring the water to a boil with Old Bay, lemon, onion and garlic.
Add the potatoes and cook 10 minutes, then the sausage and corn for 8.
Add the shrimp for the last 3 minutes and drain.

name: She-Crab-Style Soup (Lightened)
steps: Soften the onion and celery in butter.
Add the broth and milk and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the crab, Old Bay and lemon and heat gently.

name: Carolina Pulled Pork Plate with Vinegar Slaw
steps: Use cooked, shredded pork shoulder; toss with half the vinegar, pepper flakes, paprika and salt.
Toss the slaw with the rest of the vinegar and the oil.
Serve the pork with slaw and boiled potatoes.

name: Deviled Egg Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hard-boil the eggs and chop.
Mix with yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Hollow out the tomatoes and fill; dust with paprika.

name: Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, pepper and celery in the broth and tomatoes for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the sliced sausage, rice and seasoning and cook 8 minutes.

name: Cajun Shrimp Stuffed Avocado
steps: Season the shrimp and sear in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Halve the avocados.
Fill with shrimp, onion and cilantro and squeeze lime on top.

name: Peach Pecan Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia and cinnamon in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with peach and pecans.

name: Texas-Style Beef Chili without Beans
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, jalapeno and spices.
Stir in the tomatoes, paste and broth and simmer 80 minutes until tender.

name: Brisket-Style Slow Cooker Beef with Barbecue Rub
steps: Rub the beef with the spice mix.
Place on the onion in a slow cooker with the broth and vinegar.
Cook on low for 8 hours and shred or slice.

name: Smoked Turkey Breast with Dry Rub
steps: Rub the turkey with oil, vinegar and the spices.
Roast at 300°F, or smoke, until it reaches 165°F, about 2 hours.
Rest and slice.

name: Barbecue Ribs, Oven-Baked
steps: Rub the pork with the spices.
Wrap tightly and bake at 300°F for 2 hours.
Brush with a sauce of paste, vinegar and sweetener and finish under the broiler.

name: BBQ Chicken Quarters with Corn on the Cob
steps: Whisk the paste, vinegar, paprika and sweetener.
Roast the chicken at 425°F for 35 minutes, brushing with sauce.
Grill or boil the corn and brush with butter.

name: Cowboy Caviar Chicken Bowls
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice.
Mix the beans, corn, pepper, onion, lime and cilantro.
Serve over rice with chicken and avocado.

name: Tex-Mex Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, tomatoes, spices and broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the beans and corn.
Serve with strips of crisped tortilla, avocado and cilantro.

name: Carne Asada Street Tacos
steps: Marinate the steak in lime, garlic and cumin for 30 minutes.
Grill 4 minutes a side, rest and chop.
Warm the tortillas and fill with steak, onion, cilantro and salsa.

name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Poach and shred the chicken.
Simmer with chipotle, tomato sauce and onion for 10 minutes.
Crisp the tortillas in a hot oven.
Top with beans, chicken, lettuce and cotija.

name: Fish Tostadas with Lime Cabbage
steps: Season the tilapia and pan-sear 3 minutes a side.
Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Toss the cabbage with lime and yogurt.
Top the tostadas with fish, slaw and avocado.

name: Taco Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add the beans, corn, tomatoes, broth and taco seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Top with cheddar.

name: Tamale Pie Casserole
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and chili powder; stir in beans, corn and sauce.
Stir the egg into the cooked grits for the crust.
Spread the filling in a dish, cover with grits and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Midwest Hotdish with Ground Beef and Green Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and mushrooms.
Stir in the beans, milk and thyme.
Top with sliced potatoes and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and thyme in the broth for 25 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the cooked wild rice and milk.
Heat through gently.

name: Bratwurst-Style Turkey Sausage with Sauerkraut and Apple
steps: Brown the sausages in oil.
Add the onion and apple and cook until soft.
Warm the sauerkraut with them and serve with mustard.

name: Cheese Curd-Style Baked Cauliflower Bites
steps: Toss the florets in egg and almond flour.
Roast on an oiled tray at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Top with mozzarella for the last 5.

name: New England Baked Cod with Herb Crumbs
steps: Crumb the bread and mix with melted butter, parsley and garlic.
Top the cod and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Serve with lemon and steamed green beans.

name: Lobster Roll Lettuce Wraps
steps: Chop the cooked lobster.
Mix with celery, mayo, yogurt, lemon and chives.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Maine-Style Lobster Roll on a Toasted Bun
steps: Toss the cooked lobster with lemon, chives and celery.
Toast the buns in butter.
Fill generously.

name: Cape Cod Turkey Burger with Cranberry Mustard
steps: Mix the turkey with chopped cranberries and salt and shape four patties.
Pan-sear 6 minutes a side.
Toast the buns and spread with mustard.
Build with arugula and onion.

name: Hawaiian Chicken Skewers with Pineapple
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil.
Thread onto skewers with pineapple, pepper and onion.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes and serve over rice.

name: Poke Bowl with Tuna and Cucumber
steps: Cube the tuna and toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Divide the rice among bowls.
Top with tuna, cucumber, avocado, green onion, sesame seeds and nori.

name: Kalua-Style Pork with Cabbage
steps: Rub the pork with salt and paprika.
Slow cook with the water for 8 hours.
Shred and stir in the steamed cabbage.

name: Pacific Northwest Cedar-Style Salmon with Asparagus
steps: Brush the salmon with mustard, oil, garlic and dill.
Roast at 400°F for 15 minutes with the asparagus.
Serve with lemon.

name: Seattle-Style Teriyaki Chicken Plate
steps: Sear the chicken in oil, then glaze with soy sauce, ginger, garlic, vinegar and sweetener.
Steam or sauté the cabbage.
Serve with rice.

name: California Cobb Burrito Bowl
steps: Grill and slice the chicken; boil and slice the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange everything over the romaine.
Dress with lime and oil.

name: San Diego Shrimp Ceviche Cups
steps: Poach the shrimp 2 minutes, chop and chill.
Marinate in the lime juice for 20 minutes.
Fold in tomato, cucumber, onion, jalapeno and cilantro.
Serve with avocado.

name: Southwest Stuffed Peppers with Turkey and Rice
steps: Halve the peppers and parboil 4 minutes.
Brown the turkey with the spices; mix with rice, beans and tomatoes.
Fill the peppers, top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring the broth and ginger to a simmer and whisk in the arrowroot slurry.
Pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring.
Finish with green onion, sesame oil and pepper.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Simmer the broth with the mushrooms, soy sauce and pepper.
Add the tofu and arrowroot slurry.
Stir in the beaten egg and finish with vinegar and green onion.

name: Baked General Tso-Style Chicken
steps: Toss the cubed chicken in egg and arrowroot and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger, pepper flakes and sweetener for 3 minutes.
Toss with the chicken and steamed broccoli.

name: Orange Chicken with Fresh Juice
steps: Toss the cubed chicken in arrowroot and sear in oil until golden.
Simmer the orange juice, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and ginger to a glaze.
Coat the chicken and serve with broccoli and green onion.

name: Kung Pao Chicken with Peanuts
steps: Sear the chicken in oil.
Add the pepper, zucchini, garlic, ginger and pepper flakes.
Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and finish with peanuts and sesame oil.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Pineapple
steps: Sear the cubed chicken in oil.
Add the pepper and onion, then a sauce of paste, vinegar and sweetener thickened with arrowroot.
Fold in the pineapple and serve over rice.

name: Chicken Lo Mein with Vegetables
steps: Boil the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the sliced chicken in oil, add the vegetables, garlic and ginger.
Toss with the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Shrimp with Snow Peas and Garlic Sauce
steps: Sear the shrimp in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the peas, mushrooms and garlic.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and return the shrimp.

name: Mongolian-Style Beef with Scallions
steps: Slice the steak thin and toss in arrowroot.
Sear in oil in two batches.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce and sweetener, then the green onion.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Egg Foo Young
steps: Mix the beaten eggs with sprouts, shrimp, green onion and mushrooms.
Pan-fry small patties in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Simmer the broth, soy sauce and arrowroot into a gravy and spoon over.

name: Moo Shu Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Stir-fry the sliced chicken in oil.
Add the vegetables and ginger, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and spoon into lettuce.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice with Egg
steps: Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas in oil.
Scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil and finish with green onion.

name: Pork and Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and ginger in oil.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with green onion.

name: Chicken Marsala
steps: Dust the chicken with arrowroot and sear in oil.
Brown the mushrooms with garlic in butter.
Add wine and broth, return the chicken and simmer 10 minutes.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Crisp the bacon with the garlic.
Whisk the eggs with parmesan and pepper.
Toss with the hot pasta off the heat until creamy.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the vegetables and garlic in oil.
Toss together with parmesan and basil.

name: Stuffed Shells with Ricotta and Spinach
steps: Cook the shells al dente.
Mix the ricotta, wilted spinach, egg, parmesan and garlic.
Fill the shells, set on marinara in a dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.

name: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan and garlic and roll tiny meatballs.
Simmer the broth and carrot, drop in the meatballs for 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and spinach and cook until tender.

name: Antipasto Salad
steps: Chop the romaine and arrange on a platter.
Add the turkey, mozzarella, artichokes, peppers, olives and tomatoes.
Dress with vinegar and oil.

name: Caprese Chicken Skillet
steps: Sear the chicken in oil, 5 minutes a side.
Add the garlic and tomatoes and cook 4 minutes.
Top with mozzarella to melt and finish with basil and balsamic.

name: Eggplant Rollatini
steps: Slice the eggplant lengthwise and roast until pliable.
Spread with the ricotta and spinach mixture and roll.
Cover with marinara and cheeses and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Zuppa Toscana-Style Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth, potatoes and pepper flakes and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and cream and cook 5 minutes.

name: Gyro Chicken Bowls with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the chicken in oil, lemon and oregano and grill; slice.
Stir the yogurt with grated cucumber, garlic and lemon.
Build bowls from rice, chicken, tomato, onion and feta with tzatziki.

name: Greek Diner Omelet with Feta and Spinach
steps: Sauté the spinach and tomato in oil.
Add the beaten eggs and cook until nearly set.
Top with feta and oregano and fold.

name: Butter Chicken with Cauliflower Rice
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the chicken in butter.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomato sauce.
Simmer 15 minutes and stir in the cream.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Herb-Roasted Turkey Breast with Pan Gravy
steps: Rub the turkey with butter, herbs, garlic and salt and set on the onion.
Roast at 350°F until 165°F, about 90 minutes, adding broth to the pan.
Strain the juices, thicken with arrowroot into a gravy and slice.

name: Glazed Ham Steak with Pineapple
steps: Sear the ham steaks in oil.
Brush with mustard and vinegar and top with pineapple.
Broil 3 minutes.

name: Turkey Pot Pie Casserole with Cauliflower Topping
steps: Simmer the turkey, vegetables, broth, milk and thyme and thicken with arrowroot.
Spread in a dish.
Top with mashed cauliflower and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Divan Casserole
steps: Arrange the chicken and steamed broccoli in a dish.
Stir the yogurt, milk, mayo, curry powder and lemon and pour over.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Baked Spaghetti Casserole
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and stir in the marinara.
Mix the pasta with cottage cheese and half the sauce in a dish.
Top with the rest and cheeses and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: King Ranch Chicken Casserole (Lightened)
steps: Mix the shredded chicken, chiles, pepper and onion with the yogurt, broth and chili powder.
Layer with torn tortillas in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Hamburger Helper-Style Skillet with Whole Pasta
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add the tomato sauce, broth and spices and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cooked pasta and cheddar until melted.

name: Stuffed Acorn Squash with Sausage and Apple
steps: Halve and roast the squash at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Brown the sausage with onion, apple and sage.
Fill the squash and top with pecans; return to the oven for 10 minutes.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Cider Glaze
steps: Sear the pork in oil.
Roast at 400°F for 15 minutes with the apple and green beans.
Brush with mustard and vinegar and rest before slicing.

name: Rosemary Lamb Chops with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Rub the chops with rosemary, garlic and oil.
Roast with the vegetables at 425°F for 18 to 20 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

name: Standing Rib-Style Roast with Horseradish Yogurt
steps: Rub the roast with oil, garlic, rosemary, pepper and salt.
Roast at 325°F to 130°F inside for medium rare.
Rest 20 minutes and slice; serve with yogurt mixed with mustard.

name: Baked Salmon with Dijon and Dill
steps: Brush the salmon with mustard and oil.
Bake at 400°F for 12 to 15 minutes.
Finish with dill and lemon.

name: Seafood Chowder with Potatoes
steps: Crisp the bacon, soften the onion and celery.
Add the broth, potatoes and thyme and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the milk and seafood and cook 6 minutes.

name: Spinach and Mushroom Quiche without Crust
steps: Sauté the onion, mushrooms and spinach in oil.
Whisk the eggs, milk and nutmeg and pour over the vegetables and cheese in a dish.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Holiday Cheese and Veggie Platter
steps: Slice the cheeses and vegetables.
Arrange on a platter with olives and hummus.

name: Shrimp Cocktail with Horseradish Tomato Sauce
steps: Poach the shrimp 3 minutes and chill.
Stir the paste, lemon juice, hot sauce and mustard into a sauce.
Serve with lemon.

name: Bacon-Wrapped Dates, Small Portion
steps: Stuff each date with an almond.
Wrap with a strip of bacon.
Bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Pumpkin Soup with Toasted Pepitas
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the pumpkin, broth and spice and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with the cream and top with pepitas.

name: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal
steps: Mix the oats, milk, eggs, cinnamon, baking powder and vanilla.
Fold in the chopped apple and walnuts.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Turkey and Cheese Pinwheels
steps: Spread the tortillas with cream cheese.
Layer turkey, spinach and cheddar.
Roll tight and slice into rounds.

name: Mini Meatloaf Muffins
steps: Mix everything and press into a muffin tin.
Brush with a little paste.
Bake at 375°F for 22 to 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Nuggets, Baked with Almond Crumb
steps: Cut the chicken into nuggets.
Dip in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan and spices.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: Fish Sticks, Baked
steps: Cut the cod into sticks.
Dip in egg, then almond flour, parmesan and Old Bay.
Bake at 425°F for 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve with lemon yogurt dip.

name: Cheese Quesadilla Triangles
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with cheddar and beans and fold.
Crisp in a pan with oil.
Cut into triangles.

name: Ants on a Log
steps: Fill the celery stalks with peanut butter.
Press seeds on top.

name: Banana Dog Roll-Up
steps: Spread the tortillas with peanut butter.
Place a banana on each and roll.

name: Pizza Pasta Bake
steps: Brown the sausage; mix with the cooked pasta, marinara, pepper and seasoning.
Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Cheeseburger Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and carrot.
Add the potatoes, broth, mustard and paste and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the milk and cheddar.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Quesadilla
steps: Spread peanut butter and banana on half of each tortilla.
Fold and toast in a pan 2 minutes a side.

name: Scrambled Egg Muffin Cups with Ham
steps: Divide the chopped ham, pepper and spinach among six muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and top with cheddar.
Bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Yogurt-Dipped Frozen Berries
steps: Stir the vanilla into the yogurt.
Dip the berries and freeze on a tray 2 hours.

name: Lunchbox Turkey Bento with Cheddar Roll-Ups and Blueberries
steps: Roll the turkey around cheddar sticks.
Pack with cucumber, blueberries, almonds and crackers.

name: Sloppy Joes on Hamburger Buns
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper.
Add the sauce, mustard, vinegar and chili powder and simmer 12 minutes.
Spoon onto toasted buns.

name: Mac and Cheese Cups with Hidden Cauliflower
steps: Boil the pasta and cauliflower together; mash the cauliflower.
Stir with the cheddar, milk and egg.
Spoon into muffin cups and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.

name: Taco Pizza on a Tortilla
steps: Brown the turkey with taco seasoning.
Crisp the tortillas, top with turkey and cheddar and bake 6 minutes.
Add tomato, lettuce and salsa.

name: Pigs in a Blanket with Turkey Franks
steps: Cut the tortillas into strips.
Wrap around cheese-topped sausage pieces.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes and serve with mustard.

name: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Bites
steps: Mix everything.
Chill 20 minutes.
Roll into twelve balls.

name: Hummus and Veggie Snack Cups
steps: Spoon hummus into four cups.
Stand the cut vegetables in each.

name: Homemade Chicken Noodle Cups
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot and celery in the broth for 12 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the noodles and cook until tender.

name: Corn Dog Muffins with Turkey Franks
steps: Mix the cooked grits with egg, milk, cheddar and baking powder.
Press into muffin cups around sausage pieces.
Bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Egg Salad Lettuce Cups for Lunch
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Mix with yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Spoon into lettuce cups and dust with paprika.

name: Cinnamon Baked Apple Chips
steps: Slice the apples very thin.
Dust with cinnamon and arrange on lined trays.
Bake at 225°F for 80 to 90 minutes, turning once.

name: Vegan Chili with Three Beans
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the spices, tomatoes, beans and broth.
Simmer 30 minutes.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie with Mashed Potato Crust
steps: Simmer the lentils with the carrot, onion, paste, broth and thyme until tender; add peas.
Mash the potatoes with milk and butter.
Top the lentils with the mash and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchiladas
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Mix the beans, mashed sweet potato and onion.
Fill the tortillas, roll and pack in a dish.
Cover with sauce and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Eggplant and Chickpea Curry
steps: Brown the cubed eggplant in oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the curry powder.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk and eggplant and simmer 20 minutes.

name: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Burrito Bowl
steps: Crumble the tofu and sauté with the pepper, turmeric and cumin in oil.
Warm the beans and rice.
Build bowls and top with salsa and avocado.

name: Peanut Tofu Stir-Fry with Broccoli
steps: Brown the cubed tofu in oil.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger.
Whisk the peanut butter with soy sauce, vinegar and pepper flakes and toss everything together.

name: Chickpea Salad Sandwich Filling in Lettuce Cups
steps: Mash the chickpeas roughly.
Mix with yogurt, celery, onion, mustard, lemon and dill.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Quinoa and Black Beans
steps: Mix the quinoa, beans, corn, tomatoes and spices.
Fill the halved peppers and top with cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Cauliflower Steak with Chimichurri
steps: Slice the cauliflower into thick steaks and roast with half the oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Chop the parsley and mix with garlic, vinegar, remaining oil and oregano.
Spoon over the steaks.

name: Portobello Fajita Wraps
steps: Slice the mushrooms, peppers and onion and sauté in oil with the seasoning.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with vegetables and avocado and finish with lime.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Bowls
steps: Roast or warm the chickpeas.
Build bowls from quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and feta.
Dress with lemon and oil.

name: Lentil Bolognese over Zucchini Noodles
steps: Simmer the cooked lentils with the onion, carrot, garlic, marinara and seasoning for 20 minutes.
Warm the zucchini noodles briefly.
Serve topped with parmesan.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Wilt the spinach with garlic and mix with the ricotta, egg and parmesan.
Fill the caps.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Black Bean Burger Bowls with Avocado Crema
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg and spices and form four patties; pan-fry 5 minutes a side.
Blend the avocado, yogurt and lime into a crema.
Serve the patties over romaine and tomato with the crema.

name: Edamame and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
steps: Stir-fry the vegetables, garlic and ginger in a little sesame oil.
Add the edamame and soy sauce.
Serve over rice.

name: Tempeh Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Crumble the tempeh and brown in oil with the seasoning.
Toss the cabbage with lime and cilantro.
Fill warm tortillas with tempeh, slaw and avocado.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Pasta with White Beans
steps: Cook the pasta.
Simmer the garlic, tomatoes and beans, stir in the cream and basil.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Chili
steps: Soften the onion and garlic, add the spices.
Add the sweet potato, beans, tomatoes and broth and simmer 30 minutes.
Finish with lime.

name: Falafel Bowls with Tahini Sauce
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, parsley, onion, garlic, cumin and oat flour and shape patties.
Bake on an oiled tray at 400°F for 25 minutes.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and a little water.
Serve over quinoa with cucumber and tomato.

name: Vegetable Lo Mein with Tofu
steps: Boil the noodles.
Brown the tofu in oil, add the vegetables, garlic and ginger.
Toss with the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Caprese Stuffed Portobello Caps
steps: Brush the caps with oil and roast 8 minutes.
Fill with tomatoes, garlic and mozzarella.
Bake 10 minutes more and finish with basil and balsamic.

name: Quinoa Black Bean Salad Jars
steps: Mix the quinoa, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Dress with lime and oil, fold in cilantro and avocado.
Pack in jars.

name: Roasted Cauliflower and Chickpea Tacos
steps: Roast the cauliflower and chickpeas with oil and spices at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the roasted vegetables, avocado, lime and cilantro.

name: Oat Flour Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana and whisk with eggs and milk.
Stir in the oat flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Cook small pancakes in butter, 2 minutes a side.

name: Almond Flour Pancakes with Berries
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and vanilla and stir in the almond flour and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in butter.
Serve with berries.

name: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oat flour, vanilla and cinnamon.
Cook in butter 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Serve with strawberries.

name: Pumpkin Oat Pancakes
steps: Whisk the pumpkin, eggs and milk.
Stir in the oat flour, spice and baking powder.
Cook in butter 2 minutes a side.

name: Protein Waffles from Oats and Eggs
steps: Blend the oats, eggs, yogurt, baking powder and vanilla.
Cook in a greased waffle iron.
Top with blueberries.

name: Blueberry Oat Breakfast Muffins
steps: Whisk the eggs, yogurt, vanilla and sugar.
Fold in the oat flour, baking powder and blueberries.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Zucchini Bread Oatmeal Bake
steps: Mix everything and pour into a greased dish.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Casserole
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and pepper.
Layer with the spinach and cheddar in a dish.
Pour over the beaten eggs and milk and bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: Ham and Cheese Egg Roll-Ups
steps: Cook thin omelets in butter.
Top each with ham and Swiss and roll.

name: Spinach Feta Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble the eggs with the spinach in oil.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, feta and tomato and roll.

name: Chilaquiles-Style Egg Skillet
steps: Crisp torn tortillas in oil.
Warm in the salsa, then top with fried eggs.
Finish with cotija, avocado and cilantro.

name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Boats
steps: Bake the halved sweet potatoes until tender and scoop a well.
Fill with sautéed sausage and spinach.
Crack an egg into each, top with cheddar and bake 12 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Breakfast Bowl with Nuts and Seeds
steps: Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with berries, almonds and seeds and dust with cinnamon.

name: Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, peanut butter, yogurt and chia in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and top with banana.

name: Savory Oatmeal with Egg and Spinach
steps: Simmer the oats in the broth with the spinach.
Top with a poached or fried egg, parmesan and pepper.

name: Breakfast Sausage Patties with Apple
steps: Mix the turkey with grated apple, sage, thyme and salt.
Shape eight small patties.
Pan-fry in oil 5 to 6 minutes a side.

name: Cheddar Broccoli Egg Cups
steps: Divide the chopped broccoli and cheddar among six muffin cups.
Pour in the eggs whisked with milk and pepper.
Bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Sheet Pan Sausage with Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Toss everything on a tray with oil, garlic and seasoning.
Roast at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: Sheet Pan Salmon with Brussels Sprouts
steps: Roast the halved sprouts with oil at 425°F for 10 minutes.
Add the salmon brushed with mustard and garlic and roast 12 minutes more.
Serve with lemon.

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp and Vegetable Bake
steps: Toss the vegetables with oil and Old Bay and roast at 425°F for 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp and roast 5 minutes more.
Finish with lemon.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Chili
steps: Combine everything except the lime in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours.
Shred the chicken and finish with lime.

name: Slow Cooker Pot Roast Chili with Beans
steps: Combine everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 7 hours and shred the beef.

name: Slow Cooker Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Mix the turkey with egg, parmesan, onion, garlic and seasoning and shape meatballs.
Cook in the marinara on low 4 hours.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs with Smoked Paprika
steps: Rub the chicken with oil and spices.
Air fry at 380°F for 20 minutes, turning once.
Serve with steamed green beans.

name: Air Fryer Salmon with Lemon and Dill
steps: Brush the salmon with oil and seasoning.
Air fry at 390°F for 8 to 10 minutes.
Serve with lemon, dill and roasted asparagus.

name: Air Fryer Cauliflower Wings
steps: Toss the florets with oil, almond flour and garlic powder.
Air fry at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Toss with hot sauce and serve with a yogurt dill dip.

name: Air Fryer Shrimp with Garlic and Lime
steps: Toss the shrimp with oil, garlic, lime and spices.
Air fry at 400°F for 6 to 8 minutes.

name: Air Fryer Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix everything and shape twenty meatballs.
Air fry at 380°F for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Roast Beef and Horseradish Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with yogurt mixed with mustard.
Layer sliced roast beef, lettuce and tomato and roll.

name: Turkey Avocado Ranch Wrap
steps: Stir the yogurt with the ranch seasoning.
Fill the tortillas with turkey, avocado, lettuce and tomato.
Roll and halve.

name: Grilled Chicken Pesto Panini
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Layer on the bread with pesto, mozzarella and tomato.
Press in a hot pan until golden on both sides.

name: Caprese Sandwich on Ezekiel Bread
steps: Toast the bread.
Layer mozzarella, tomato and basil and drizzle with oil and balsamic.

name: Hummus and Roasted Vegetable Sandwich
steps: Roast the sliced vegetables in oil at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Spread the bread with hummus and pile on the vegetables and arugula.

name: Egg and Avocado Breakfast Sandwich on English Muffin
steps: Toast the muffins and fry the eggs.
Layer avocado, spinach, tomato and egg.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocado
steps: Mix the tuna with celery, yogurt, mustard, lemon and chives.
Fill the halved avocados.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad with Yogurt Dressing
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Blend the yogurt, lemon, garlic, mustard, oil and anchovy into a dressing.
Toss with the romaine and top with chicken and parmesan.

name: Greek Chicken Salad with Tzatziki
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Arrange the vegetables, olives and feta.
Mix the yogurt, lemon and garlic into a tzatziki and spoon on top.

name: Asian Chicken Salad with Sesame Dressing
steps: Shred the chicken and combine with cabbage, carrot, edamame and green onion.
Whisk the vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, peanut butter and ginger and toss through.

name: Spinach Strawberry Salad with Pecans
steps: Toss the spinach with strawberries, onion and pecans.
Dress with balsamic and oil and top with goat cheese.

name: Kale Caesar with Chickpea Croutons
steps: Roast the chickpeas with a little oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Massage the kale with the yogurt, lemon, garlic, mustard and oil.
Top with parmesan and the chickpeas.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato and Black Bean Salad
steps: Toss the sweet potato with oil and cumin and roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Combine with beans, arugula and onion.
Dress with lime and cilantro.

name: Cucumber Dill Chicken Salad Cups
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with yogurt, dill, lemon and onion.
Spoon into thick cucumber cups.

name: Wedge Salad with Blue Cheese and Tomatoes
steps: Cut the lettuce into wedges.
Blend the blue cheese, yogurt and lemon into a dressing.
Top with tomatoes, onion and crisp bacon.

name: Marinated Mushroom and Artichoke Salad
steps: Toss everything with the vinegar, oil and seasoning.
Marinate 30 minutes.

name: Taco Salad with Lime Crema
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning.
Arrange the romaine, beans, tomato and avocado in bowls.
Add the beef and cheddar and top with yogurt stirred with lime.

name: Antipasto Skewers
steps: Thread the mozzarella, tomatoes, olives, artichokes and basil onto skewers.
Drizzle with balsamic and oil.

name: Buffalo Chicken Thigh Bites with Celery and Blue Cheese
steps: Toss the chicken with baking powder and garlic powder and bake at 425°F for 40 minutes.
Toss with melted butter and hot sauce.
Serve with celery and blue cheese.

name: Caprese Dip with Veggie Dippers
steps: Mix the cream cheese, mozzarella, chopped tomatoes, basil and garlic in a dish.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.
Serve with the vegetables.

name: Edamame with Sea Salt and Lime
steps: Boil the edamame 5 minutes.
Toss with lime and salt.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus with Crudités
steps: Blend the chickpeas, red pepper, tahini, lemon, garlic and oil until smooth.
Serve with the vegetables.

name: Stuffed Mini Peppers with Cream Cheese and Chives
steps: Halve and seed the mini peppers.
Mix the cream cheese with chives and garlic powder.
Fill and dust with everything seasoning.

name: Spicy Roasted Chickpea Crunch
steps: Dry the chickpeas well and toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 400°F for 25 to 30 minutes until crisp.

name: Cheddar and Apple Slices with Walnuts
steps: Slice the apple and cheddar.
Serve with the walnuts.

name: Cottage Cheese with Cherry Tomatoes and Everything Seasoning
steps: Top the cottage cheese with halved tomatoes.
Finish with oil and everything seasoning.

name: Creamy Cauliflower and Leek Soup
steps: Soften the leek and garlic in oil.
Add the cauliflower and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with the milk and nutmeg.

name: Lentil and Spinach Soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth and cumin and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and lemon.

name: Butternut Squash Soup with Sage
steps: Roast the squash at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Soften the onion in oil, add the squash, broth and sage and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend with the cream.

name: Chicken Zucchini Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken and vegetables in the broth 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the zucchini noodles and heat 2 minutes.

name: Miso Mushroom Soup with Tofu
steps: Simmer the mushrooms and ginger in the broth 8 minutes.
Add the tofu and spinach.
Whisk in the miso off the heat and finish with green onion.

name: Tomato Basil Soup with White Beans
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend and finish with basil.

name: Turkey Vegetable Soup with Kale
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion.
Add the vegetables, tomatoes, broth and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the kale for the last 5.

name: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin Medallions
steps: Slice the pork into medallions and rub with garlic, herbs and mustard.
Sear in oil 3 minutes a side.
Roast the asparagus alongside for 10 minutes.

name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Pan Sauce
steps: Sear the seasoned chops in oil; set aside.
Brown the mushrooms and garlic in butter, add broth and thyme and reduce.
Return the chops and simmer 6 minutes.

name: Grilled Sirloin with Chimichurri and Roasted Zucchini
steps: Grill the steak to taste and rest.
Chop the parsley with garlic, vinegar, oil and oregano.
Roast the zucchini slices and serve everything together.

name: Italian Beef Stew with Peppers and Tomatoes
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, peppers, tomatoes, broth and seasoning.
Simmer covered 100 minutes until tender.

name: Steak Tips with Garlic Butter Mushrooms
steps: Sear the cubed steak in a hot pan, 2 minutes a side, and set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in butter with garlic.
Return the steak and finish with parsley.

name: Beef and Vegetable Kebabs
steps: Marinate the beef cubes in oil, spices and lemon.
Thread onto skewers with the vegetables.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning.

name: Lamb Burgers with Feta and Cucumber Yogurt
steps: Mix the lamb with feta, garlic, cumin and half the mint and shape four patties.
Grill 5 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt with grated cucumber and the rest of the mint.
Serve in lettuce with the sauce.

name: Slow Cooker Lamb Shoulder with Rosemary and Garlic
steps: Stud the lamb with garlic and rosemary.
Set on the onion and carrots in the slow cooker with broth and lemon.
Cook on low 7 hours.

name: Greek Lamb Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix the lamb, egg, oat bran, garlic and oregano and shape meatballs.
Brown, then simmer in the marinara 15 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Ground Beef and Cabbage Skillet
