steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the cabbage, paste, broth and paprika.
Cook covered 12 minutes.

name: Taco-Stuffed Zucchini Boats
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Halve and scoop out the zucchini.
Brown the beef with the seasoning and sauce.
Fill the boats, top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Beef Stir-Fry with Snap Peas and Peppers
steps: Toss the sliced steak in arrowroot and sear in oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Combine with soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Meatball Marinara Bake with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Mix the meats, egg, parmesan and seasoning and shape meatballs.
Bake in the marinara at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Top with mozzarella and serve over the zucchini noodles.

name: Pork Carnitas Bowls with Cabbage and Lime
steps: Rub the pork with the spices and slow cook with orange juice and garlic for 7 hours.
Shred and crisp under the broiler.
Serve over cabbage with lime, avocado and cilantro.

name: Pozole Rojo with Pork
steps: Simmer the pork with the onion, garlic, chili powder, oregano and broth for 70 minutes.
Add the beans and cook 15 minutes.
Serve with cabbage, radish and lime.

name: Barbacoa-Style Beef Tacos
steps: Slow cook the beef with chipotle, lime, cumin, garlic and onion for 7 hours.
Shred and serve in warm tortillas with cilantro.

name: Grilled Pork Souvlaki with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the pork cubes in lemon, garlic, oregano and oil.
Skewer and grill 10 to 12 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with grated cucumber, dill and garlic.
Serve in warm pitas.

name: Italian Sausage with Peppers and Onions over Polenta-Style Grits
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the peppers, onion and marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over grits stirred with parmesan.

name: Pork Chops with Sauteed Apples and Onions
steps: Sear the chops in oil; set aside.
Cook the apple and onion in butter with thyme.
Add the vinegar, return the chops and simmer 6 minutes.

name: Corned Beef-Style Brisket with Cabbage and Carrots
steps: Simmer the beef in the broth with vinegar, onion, bay and pepper for 2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots for 30 minutes, then the cabbage for the last 20.

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Mix the beef, egg, oat bran and mustard and form oval patties; brown.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the pan, add broth thickened with arrowroot.
Return the patties and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Moroccan-Spiced Lamb with Chickpeas
steps: Brown the cubed lamb with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, chickpeas and broth and simmer 80 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Beef and Bean Burrito Bowls
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning.
Build bowls from rice, beans, beef and lettuce.
Top with tomato, avocado, cheddar and salsa.

name: Hawaiian Pork Chops with Pineapple Salsa
steps: Rub the chops with paprika and oil and grill 6 minutes a side.
Mix the pineapple, onion, cilantro, lime and jalapeno.
Serve the salsa over the chops.

name: Spicy Pork Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and ginger.
Add the water chestnuts, soy sauce and sriracha.
Spoon into lettuce cups with green onion and sesame oil.

name: Venison Chili
steps: Brown the venison with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 50 minutes.

name: Bison Meatloaf with Mushrooms
steps: Sauté the chopped mushrooms and onion.
Mix with the bison, egg, oat bran and salt and press into a loaf pan.
Spread with paste and bake at 375°F for 50 minutes.

name: Pan-Seared Halibut with Lemon Caper Sauce
steps: Sear the halibut in half the butter, 4 minutes a side.
Sauté the garlic and spinach.
Warm the lemon, capers and remaining butter and spoon over.

name: Blackened Mahi Mahi Tacos with Mango Slaw
steps: Coat the fish in the seasoning and sear in oil, 4 minutes a side.
Toss the cabbage with mango, lime and cilantro.
Flake the fish into warm tortillas with the slaw.

name: Baked Trout with Almonds and Green Beans
steps: Bake the trout at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Brown the almonds in butter and add the lemon.
Steam the beans and spoon the almond butter over everything.

name: Seared Sea Scallops with Cauliflower Puree
steps: Boil and blend the cauliflower with milk, garlic and half the butter.
Sear the dried scallops in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Serve over the puree with chives and the remaining butter.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp over Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast and shred the squash.
Sauté the garlic in butter, cook the shrimp 3 minutes.
Add lemon and toss with the squash and parsley.

name: Cod Veracruz with Tomatoes and Olives
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and jalapeno in oil.
Add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer 10 minutes.
Nestle in the cod and cook 8 minutes; finish with cilantro.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Bowls with Broccoli
steps: Bake the salmon brushed with soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, garlic and sweetener at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Steam the broccoli.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds.

name: Tuna Poke Salad with Avocado and Cucumber
steps: Cube the tuna and marinate with soy sauce, sesame oil and lime.
Arrange over lettuce with cucumber and avocado.
Top with green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Grilled Swordfish with Tomato Olive Relish
steps: Grill the swordfish 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Mix the tomatoes, olives, capers, basil, oil and vinegar.
Spoon over the fish.

name: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Remove the mushroom stems.
Mix the crab, cream cheese, parmesan, Old Bay, green onion and lemon.
Fill the caps and bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp and Broccoli Skillet
steps: Sauté the garlic in butter, cook the shrimp 3 minutes and set aside.
Steam-sauté the broccoli in the pan.
Return the shrimp and finish with lemon.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Bok Choy
steps: Whisk the miso, vinegar, ginger and sweetener and brush on the cod.
Bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Sauté the bok choy in sesame oil.

name: Sardine and Avocado Toast
ing: Sardines, canned in olive oil, drained
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon and spread.
Top with sardines, pepper flakes and parsley.

name: Mackerel with Roasted Fennel and Orange
steps: Roast the sliced fennel with oil at 425°F for 12 minutes.
Add the mackerel and orange slices and roast 10 minutes.

name: Snapper Veracruz-Style with Roasted Peppers
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil, add the tomato and peppers.
Add the olives and snapper and cook covered 12 minutes.
Finish with lime.

name: Seared Tuna Steak with Avocado Mash
steps: Sear the tuna 90 seconds a side and slice.
Mash the avocado with lime.
Serve with cucumber, soy sauce and sesame seeds.

name: Shrimp and Avocado Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Poach and chop the shrimp.
Mix with avocado, lime, onion and cilantro.
Fill the hollowed tomatoes.

name: Clam Linguine with White Wine and Garlic
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the garlic in oil, add the clams and wine and cover until they open.
Toss with the pasta and parsley.

name: Lobster Tail with Lemon Butter and Asparagus
steps: Split and broil the lobster tails 8 minutes.
Melt the butter with garlic and lemon.
Roast the asparagus and serve with the lobster and butter.

name: Fish Chowder with Corn and Potatoes
steps: Crisp the bacon, soften the onion and celery.
Add the broth, potatoes, corn and thyme and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the milk and cod and cook 8 minutes.

name: Cioppino-Style Seafood Stew
steps: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the cod, then shrimp and mussels, and cook until the shells open.

name: Zucchini Lasagna with Turkey Ricotta Filling
steps: Slice the zucchini lengthwise and salt to draw out water.
Brown the turkey and stir in the marinara; mix the ricotta with egg and parmesan.
Layer zucchini, ricotta, sauce and mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Classic Meat Lasagna
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and stir in the marinara and seasoning.
Mix the ricotta with egg and parmesan.
Layer cooked noodles, ricotta, sauce and mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes.

name: Chicken Parmesan Meatball Skillet
steps: Mix the chicken, egg, parmesan, oat bran and garlic and shape meatballs.
Brown them and simmer in the marinara 12 minutes.
Top with mozzarella to melt and finish with basil.

name: Sausage and Broccoli Rabe Orecchiette Style Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Brown the sausage with garlic and pepper flakes, add the broccolini.
Toss with the pasta, oil and parmesan.

name: Shrimp Fra Diavolo over Spaghetti
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Simmer the garlic, pepper flakes, wine and tomatoes 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp for 4 minutes and toss with the pasta and basil.

name: Turkey Sausage Minestrone
steps: Brown the sausage.
Add the vegetables, tomatoes, beans, broth and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the kale for the last 5.

name: Baked Gnocchi-Style Cauliflower with Marinara and Mozzarella
steps: Roast the florets in oil at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Toss with the marinara and garlic in a dish.
Top with cheeses and bake 12 minutes; finish with basil.

name: Italian Chopped Chicken Salad
steps: Chop the romaine and combine with chicken, chickpeas, tomatoes, mozzarella and onion.
Dress with vinegar, oil and seasoning.

name: Pizza-Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Halve the peppers and parboil 4 minutes.
Brown the sausage with the mushrooms and stir in the marinara.
Fill the peppers, top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Pesto Chicken with Roasted Tomatoes and Zucchini
steps: Spread the chicken with pesto.
Roast with the tomatoes and zucchini in oil at 400°F for 22 minutes.
Top with mozzarella for the last 3.

name: Chicken Burrito Smothered with Enchilada Sauce
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Cook and shred the chicken; mix with beans, rice and onion.
Roll in tortillas and set seam-down in a dish.
Cover with sauce and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Beef Chimichangas, Baked
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning and mix with the beans.
Fill the tortillas with beef and cheddar, fold and brush with oil.
Bake at 425°F for 15 to 18 minutes and serve with salsa.

name: Chicken Tamale Pie Muffins
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Stir the egg into the cooked grits and press into muffin cups.
Fill with shredded chicken, beans, corn and sauce and top with cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 22 to 25 minutes.

name: Huevos Divorciados
steps: Crisp the tortillas and top with beans.
Fry the eggs and set one on each side.
Spoon red salsa over one and green over the other; finish with cotija and avocado.

name: Mexican Street Corn Salad in a Cup
steps: Char the corn in a hot pan.
Mix with yogurt, lime and chili powder.
Fold in the cotija, onion and cilantro.

name: Black Bean and Corn Quesadillas
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with beans, corn and cheese and fold.
Crisp in a pan with oil, 2 minutes a side.
Serve with salsa.

name: Shredded Chicken Tostadas
steps: Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Spread with beans, top with poached shredded chicken and lettuce.
Finish with tomato, avocado, cotija and lime.

name: Chicken Mole-Style Skillet
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the chicken.
Simmer the onion, garlic, sauce, cocoa, chili, cinnamon, almonds and broth into a sauce.
Return the chicken and cook 20 minutes.

name: Fish Tacos Baja with Cabbage Crema
steps: Season and pan-sear the tilapia in oil.
Toss the cabbage with yogurt, lime and cilantro.
Fill warm tortillas with fish, slaw and avocado.

name: Carne Guisada, Slow-Simmered Beef
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, pepper, broth and potatoes.
Simmer covered 100 minutes.

name: Menudo-Style Beef Soup
steps: Simmer the beef with the onion, garlic, chili and oregano in the broth for 2 hours.
Add the beans and cook 20 minutes.
Serve with lime and cilantro.

name: Sopa de Lima with Chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, garlic, tomato and jalapeno in the broth 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the lime.
Serve with crisp tortilla strips and cilantro.

name: Refried Bean and Cheese Burrito
steps: Warm the beans.
Fill the tortillas with beans, cheddar and salsa and roll.

name: Chicken Taquitos, Baked
steps: Mix the shredded chicken with cream cheese, salsa and cheddar.
Fill and roll warmed tortillas and brush with oil.
Bake at 425°F for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: Chicken Salad Lettuce Sandwiches
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with celery, yogurt, mustard, lemon and almonds.
Pile into large lettuce leaves.

name: Open-Faced Turkey Melt with Apple and Cheddar
steps: Spread the toast with mustard.
Top with turkey, apple slices and cheddar.
Broil until melted.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich with Cucumber
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Mix with yogurt, mustard and chives.
Spread on the bread with sliced cucumber.

name: Falafel Pita with Tahini and Tomato
steps: Mash the chickpeas with parsley and lemon into a quick falafel-style mix.
Stuff the pitas with it and tomato and cucumber.
Drizzle with tahini thinned with lemon.

name: Tuna Melt on Whole Grain
steps: Mix the tuna with yogurt and celery.
Pile on toast with tomato and cheddar and broil until melted.

name: Bunless Burger Bowls with Special Sauce
steps: Brown the beef.
Mix the yogurt, paste and mustard into a sauce.
Build bowls from lettuce, beef, tomato, pickle, onion and cheddar with the sauce.

name: Cuban-Style Pork and Swiss Wrap
steps: Roast and slice the pork.
Layer with ham, Swiss, pickle and mustard in the tortillas.
Press in a hot pan until crisp.

name: Greek Chicken Pita with Tzatziki
steps: Season the chicken with oregano and lemon and sear; slice.
Stir the yogurt with cucumber and garlic.
Fill the pitas.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wrap with Ranch
steps: Cook and shred the chicken and toss with the hot sauce.
Stir the yogurt with the ranch seasoning.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, lettuce, celery and ranch.

name: Garden Veggie Wrap with Hummus
steps: Spread the tortillas with hummus.
Layer the vegetables and feta and roll.

name: Turkey Chili Stuffed Baked Potatoes
steps: Bake the potatoes.
Brown the turkey with the onion, add the spices, tomatoes and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Split the potatoes and fill with chili and cheddar.

name: Chicken Enchilada Casserole with Zucchini
ing: Red enchilada sauce, no sugar added
steps: Layer the sliced zucchini, shredded chicken, beans, onion and sauce with torn tortillas in a dish.
Top with cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Broccoli Chicken Rice Bake
steps: Mix the cooked rice, chicken, broccoli, onion, milk and garlic powder in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Ham and Potato Casserole
steps: Layer the sliced potatoes, ham, onion and peas in a dish.
Pour over the warm milk and butter and top with cheddar.
Bake covered at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Cheesy Cauliflower and Turkey Bake
steps: Roast the florets until tender.
Combine with the diced turkey, onion, garlic and milk in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Hearty Chicken and Vegetable Stew
steps: Brown the chicken, then simmer with the onion, carrot, celery, thyme and broth 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes and peas and cook 12 minutes.
Thicken with an arrowroot slurry.

name: Split Pea Soup with Smoked Turkey
steps: Simmer everything 70 minutes until the peas break down.
Remove the bay leaf.

name: Sausage Kale and White Bean Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale for the last 5.

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup (Lightened)
steps: Brown the mushrooms and onion in butter with garlic and thyme.
Add the broth and simmer 12 minutes.
Blend half, then stir in the milk.

name: Chicken and Dumpling-Style Soup with Cauliflower
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and cauliflower in the broth 20 minutes.
Mix the almond flour and egg and drop small spoonfuls into the soup.
Cover and cook 8 minutes; finish with parsley.

name: Denver Omelet Muffins
steps: Divide the diced ham, pepper, onion and cheddar among six muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Breakfast Pizza on a Tortilla
steps: Crisp the tortillas, spread with marinara and top with sausage, spinach and mozzarella.
Crack an egg on each and bake at 400°F until set, about 8 minutes.

name: Brunch Egg Bake with Spinach and Tomato
steps: Layer the spinach, tomatoes, onion and feta in a dish.
Pour over the whisked eggs and milk and bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Smoked Salmon Scramble with Chives
steps: Scramble the eggs gently in butter.
Fold in the cream cheese and salmon and finish with chives.

name: Breakfast Burrito Bowl with Sweet Potato
steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes.
Scramble the eggs in oil.
Build bowls with beans, eggs, avocado and salsa.

name: Bacon and Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Crisp the bacon.
Cook the cauliflower rice in the fat, scramble in the eggs and spinach.
Season with soy sauce and finish with green onion.

name: Spinach Mushroom Frittata
steps: Sauté the onion, mushrooms and spinach in an ovenproof pan.
Pour in the eggs and parmesan, cook 4 minutes, then bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

name: Ricotta Toast with Berries
steps: Toast the bread and spread with ricotta.
Top with berries, walnuts and cinnamon.

name: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Hash with Peppers
steps: Brown the sausage and set aside.
Cook the diced sweet potato, pepper and onion in oil until tender.
Return the sausage, make wells and cook the eggs in them.

name: Taco Salad Bowl with Chicken and Black Beans
steps: Season and sear the chicken; slice.
Arrange lettuce, beans, corn and tomato in bowls.
Top with chicken, avocado, salsa and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Cobb-Style Chopped Salad with Turkey
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange the lettuce with turkey, egg, bacon, avocado, tomato and blue cheese.
Dress with vinegar and oil.

name: Lentil Salad with Feta and Cucumber
steps: Combine the cooked lentils, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and parsley.
Dress with lemon and oil and top with feta.

name: Shaved Brussels Sprout Salad with Parmesan
steps: Shave the sprouts thin.
Toss with lemon, oil and mustard and top with parmesan and almonds.

name: Salmon Niçoise-Style Salad
steps: Roast the salmon at 400°F for 12 minutes; boil the potatoes and beans.
Arrange everything over greens with eggs, olives and tomatoes.
Dress with mustard, vinegar and oil.

name: Roasted Vegetable and Chickpea Grain Bowl
steps: Roast the vegetables and chickpeas with oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Serve over quinoa with tahini whisked with lemon.

name: Cucumber Edamame Salad with Sesame
steps: Boil the edamame 5 minutes and cool.
Toss with cucumber, vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce, sesame seeds and green onion.

name: Pesto Zucchini Noodle Salad with Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Toss the zucchini noodles with pesto.
Add halved tomatoes, mozzarella and pine nuts.

name: Pumpkin Seed and Cranberry Spinach Salad with Chicken
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Toss the spinach with seeds, cranberries and goat cheese.
Dress with vinegar, oil and mustard and top with chicken.

name: Deviled Egg Salad Bites on Cucumber
steps: Hard-boil and mash the eggs with yogurt and mustard.
Spoon onto cucumber rounds and dust with paprika and chives.

name: Baked Parmesan Zucchini Fries
steps: Cut the zucchini into sticks, dip in egg then the almond flour and parmesan mix.
Bake at 425°F for 20 to 22 minutes.
Serve with warm marinara.

name: Greek Yogurt Ranch Veggie Dip Cups
steps: Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt.
Spoon into cups and add the vegetable sticks.

name: Pesto Chicken Skewers
steps: Toss the chicken cubes with pesto and oil.
Thread onto skewers with tomatoes and zucchini.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Salmon Salad Cucumber Bites
steps: Mix the salmon with yogurt, dill, lemon and capers.
Spoon onto thick cucumber rounds.

name: Saag Chicken with Spinach and Spices
steps: Brown the chicken in ghee.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the spices and add the blended spinach.
Return the chicken, stir in the yogurt and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in oil with the spices.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Red Lentil Dal with Spinach
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the spices in oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

name: Tandoori-Style Chicken Thighs with Cucumber Raita
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt with spices, garlic, ginger and lemon.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.
Stir the rest of the yogurt with grated cucumber and mint.

name: Shrimp Curry with Coconut Milk
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the shrimp and spinach for 4 minutes; serve over rice.

name: Cauliflower and Potato Curry (Aloo Gobi)
steps: Soften the onion and spices in oil.
Add the cauliflower, potatoes and tomatoes with a splash of water.
Cover and cook 20 minutes; finish with cilantro.

name: Pad Thai with Shirataki Noodles and Shrimp
steps: Rinse the shirataki well.
Sear the shrimp in oil, scramble in the egg.
Add the noodles, sauce of fish sauce, paste and lime, then sprouts.
Top with peanuts and green onion.

name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Fry the curry paste, add the coconut milk and simmer.
Add the chicken and vegetables and cook 15 minutes.
Finish with basil and fish sauce and serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry the garlic and chicken in oil.
Add the vegetables, soy sauce, fish sauce and chili.
Fold in the basil and serve over rice.

name: Tom Kha Gai-Style Coconut Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer the broth, lemongrass and ginger 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, mushrooms and coconut milk and cook 12 minutes.
Finish with lime, fish sauce and cilantro.

name: Bibimbap-Style Bowls with Egg and Vegetables
steps: Sauté each vegetable separately with a little sesame oil.
Fry the eggs.
Arrange over rice and top with gochujang and sesame seeds.

name: Korean Chicken Thighs with Gochujang Glaze
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and sesame oil and coat the chicken.
Roast at 425°F for 28 minutes.
Serve with sautéed bok choy and sesame seeds.

name: Japchae-Style Stir-Fried Vegetables with Beef
steps: Rinse the shirataki and stir-fry with the sliced beef.
Add the vegetables and garlic.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with seeds.

name: Chicken Ramen-Style Noodle Soup with Soy Egg
steps: Simmer the broth with ginger, soy sauce and mushrooms.
Poach the chicken in it, then slice.
Boil the soba and eggs separately.
Assemble bowls with bok choy, egg, chicken and green onion.

name: Chicken Katsu-Style Baked Cutlets with Cabbage
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg then almond flour and parmesan and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Shred the cabbage with vinegar and sesame oil.
Serve with a quick sauce of paste thinned with vinegar.

name: Salmon Sushi Bowls with Cucumber and Avocado
steps: Season the rice with the vinegar.
Top with salmon, cucumber, avocado, shredded nori and sesame seeds.
Serve with soy sauce.

name: Edamame Miso Soup with Spinach
steps: Simmer the broth, edamame and tofu 5 minutes.
Add the spinach.
Whisk in the miso off the heat and top with green onion.

name: Vietnamese Banh Mi Bowls with Pork
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and fish sauce.
Quick-pickle the carrot and daikon in lime.
Serve over rice with cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho-Style Soup
steps: Simmer the broth with ginger, onion, star anise and chicken 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Serve over rinsed shirataki with sprouts, basil, lime and jalapeno.

name: Summer Rolls with Shrimp and Peanut Dip
steps: Poach and halve the shrimp.
Wrap with lettuce, cucumber, carrot, mint and cabbage in large leaves.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce and lime into a dip.

name: Lemongrass Pork Meatballs with Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mix the pork with minced lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and green onion and shape meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Serve in lettuce with mint and cucumber.

name: Spicy Tuna Roll Salad with Cucumber
steps: Mix the tuna with sriracha and yogurt.
Toss the cucumber with vinegar and spoon the tuna on top.
Add avocado, nori and sesame.

name: Sesame Ginger Salmon with Bok Choy
steps: Brush the salmon with soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Sauté the bok choy and serve with seeds.

name: Hot and Sweet Tofu with Broccoli
steps: Crisp the cubed tofu in oil.
Stir-fry the broccoli and garlic.
Add the sriracha, soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and toss.

name: Coconut Shrimp Soup with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Fry the curry paste and add the coconut milk and broth.
Simmer 5 minutes, add the shrimp for 3.
Stir in the zucchini noodles, lime and cilantro.

name: Egg Roll in a Bowl with Ground Chicken
steps: Brown the chicken with garlic and ginger in oil.
Add the slaw mix and soy sauce and cook 6 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls with Garlic Yogurt
steps: Marinate the chicken in spices, garlic, lemon and oil and roast at 425°F for 20 minutes; slice.
Stir the yogurt with garlic and lemon.
Serve over quinoa with cucumber, tomato and parsley.

name: Lamb Kofta with Tahini Sauce
steps: Mix the lamb with parsley, onion and spices and shape on skewers.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and a little water and serve with cucumber and tomato.

name: Shakshuka-Style Baked Eggs with Chickpeas and Spinach
steps: Soften the onion in oil with the spices and harissa.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 8 minutes with the spinach.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.

name: Mujaddara-Style Lentils and Rice with Caramelized Onions
steps: Cook the onions slowly in oil until deep golden.
Combine the cooked lentils and rice with half the onions and the cumin.
Top with the rest of the onions and serve with yogurt and parsley.

name: Chicken and Chickpea Tagine
steps: Brown the chicken, then soften the onion and garlic with the spices.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and olives and simmer covered 35 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Stuffed Grape-Leaf-Style Cabbage with Rice and Herbs
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves.
Mix the rice, herbs, onion, lemon and paste; roll in the leaves.
Pack in a pot with oil and water and simmer 35 minutes.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup (Avgolemono)
steps: Simmer the chicken in the broth; shred it and cook the rice in the broth.
Whisk the eggs with lemon and temper with hot broth.
Stir back in off the heat and add dill.

name: Spanakopita-Style Spinach and Feta Egg Bake
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and spinach in oil.
Mix with the eggs, feta and dill and pour into a dish.
Bake at 375°F for 28 to 30 minutes.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Plate with Lemon Potatoes
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic and oil; skewer and grill.
Roast the potatoes in lemon and oil.
Serve with cucumber yogurt.

name: Moussaka-Style Eggplant and Turkey Bake
steps: Roast the sliced eggplant.
Brown the turkey with onion, garlic and cinnamon and add the tomatoes.
Layer with the eggplant and top with yogurt whisked with egg and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Jamaican Jerk Chicken with Pineapple Slaw
steps: Blend the spices, garlic, ginger, lime and soy sauce and coat the chicken.
Roast at 425°F for 30 to 35 minutes.
Toss the cabbage with pineapple, lime and cilantro.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice Bowls
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil with the spices.
Add the beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over rice with lime and cilantro.

name: Ropa Vieja-Style Shredded Beef
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Simmer the beef in water until tender and shred.
Cook the onion, pepper and garlic in the sauce with spices.
Add the beef and olives and serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Peruvian-Style Roasted Chicken with Green Sauce
steps: Rub the chicken with spices, garlic, lime and oil and roast at 425°F for 40 minutes.
Blend the cilantro, jalapeno, yogurt and a little lime into a green sauce.

name: Argentinian Beef Empanada Filling Bowls
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and spices.
Fold in the chopped olives and sliced boiled egg.
Serve over rice.

name: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew
steps: Brown the sausage and pork with the onion and garlic.
Add the beans, bay, broth and orange and simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with sautéed collards.

name: Cuban Picadillo over Cauliflower Rice
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, pepper and garlic.
Add the sauce, olives, capers and cumin and simmer 12 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Moroccan Chickpea and Carrot Salad
steps: Grate the carrots and toss with chickpeas, lemon, oil, cumin and harissa.
Top with parsley and feta.

name: Baba Ganoush with Vegetable Sticks
steps: Roast the eggplant until collapsed, scoop out the flesh.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic and oil.
Serve with the vegetable sticks.

name: Za'atar Roasted Chicken with Cauliflower
steps: Toss the chicken and cauliflower with oil, za'atar and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.
Serve with lemon yogurt.

name: Turkish-Style Red Lentil Soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in oil with the spices.
Add the lentils and broth and simmer 22 minutes.
Blend and finish with lemon.

name: Egg and Sausage Breakfast Tacos on Corn Tortillas
steps: Brown the sausage and scramble in the eggs.
Warm the tortillas and fill.
Top with cheddar, salsa and avocado.

name: Ham and Spinach Quiche Cups
steps: Divide the ham, spinach and Swiss among six greased cups.
Pour in the eggs whisked with milk and nutmeg.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Chia Breakfast Cookies
steps: Mash the banana and mix everything.
Scoop ten cookies onto a tray.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

name: Cottage Cheese Egg Scramble with Chives
steps: Scramble the eggs in butter and fold in the cottage cheese.
Finish with chives and pepper.

name: Apple Cheddar Oatmeal
steps: Simmer the oats in water with the diced apple.
Top with cheddar and cinnamon.

name: Greek Yogurt Pancake Stack with Peaches
steps: Whisk the yogurt, eggs and vanilla; fold in the oat flour and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in butter.
Stack with sliced peaches.

name: Egg and Veggie Breakfast Quesadilla with Black Beans
steps: Scramble the eggs with the pepper.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, beans and cheddar and crisp in a pan.
Serve with salsa.

name: Banana Walnut Baked Oatmeal Cups
steps: Mash the banana and mix with the eggs, milk, oats, cinnamon and baking powder.
Fold in the walnuts and fill muffin cups.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Turkey Bacon Wrapped Egg Muffins
steps: Line six muffin cups with turkey bacon.
Fill with spinach, egg and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Sweet Potato Hash Browns
steps: Grate the sweet potato and onion and mix with the egg and seasonings.
Pan-fry thin patties in oil, 5 to 6 minutes a side.

name: Cinnamon Roasted Chickpeas Snack
steps: Dry the chickpeas and toss with oil.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes and toss with cinnamon and sweetener.

name: Mini Caprese Skewers with Balsamic
steps: Thread the mozzarella, tomato and basil.
Drizzle with balsamic.

name: Turkey Pepperoni-Style Zucchini Pizza Bites
steps: Slice the zucchini into thick rounds.
Top with marinara, mozzarella and sausage.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

name: Avocado Egg Salad Boats
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Mix with yogurt, mustard and chives.
Fill the avocado halves.

name: Shrimp and Cucumber Rounds with Dill Cream Cheese
steps: Poach the shrimp and chill.
Spread the cucumber rounds with cream cheese mixed with dill and lemon.
Top with shrimp.

name: Spicy Edamame Hummus
steps: Blend the edamame with tahini, lemon, garlic, sriracha and oil.
Serve with cucumber.

name: Turkey Reuben Sandwich on Rye
steps: Layer the turkey, Swiss and sauerkraut on mustard-spread rye.
Grill in butter until golden and melted.

name: Chicken Avocado Club Wrap
steps: Layer the chicken, avocado, bacon, tomato and lettuce in the tortillas.
Roll and halve.

name: Open-Faced Egg and Avocado Toast with Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado.
Top with sliced tomato and fried egg and pepper flakes.

name: Italian Sub in a Lettuce Boat
steps: Fill the romaine leaves with turkey, ham, mozzarella, tomato and onion.
Dress with vinegar and oil.

name: Pulled Chicken Sliders on Small Buns
steps: Poach and shred the chicken and toss with a sauce of paste, vinegar and paprika.
Mix the slaw with the yogurt.
Fill the small buns.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Pita with Olives and Cucumber
steps: Mix the tuna with olives, cucumber, onion, lemon and oil.
Stuff the pitas.

name: Cheesy Spinach Mushroom Quesadilla
steps: Sauté the mushrooms, spinach and garlic.
Fill the tortillas with the vegetables and cheese and crisp in a pan.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel Thins with Cucumber
steps: Split and toast the bagel.
Spread with cream cheese and layer salmon, cucumber, capers and dill.

name: Barbecue Chicken Salad Sandwich Cups
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with paste, vinegar, celery, onion and yogurt.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Steak and Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Sauté the sliced steak, onion and pepper.
Fill the mushroom caps, top with Swiss and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

name: BBQ Chicken Salad with Corn and Black Beans
steps: Grill the chicken with a paste and vinegar rub; slice.
Arrange the romaine, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Top with chicken, avocado and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Greek Chickpea Salad with Feta
steps: Toss everything together and let stand 15 minutes.

name: Broccoli Cranberry Salad with Yogurt Dressing
steps: Chop the broccoli finely.
Mix the yogurt and vinegar and toss with the broccoli, cranberries, seeds and onion.
Top with crumbled bacon.

name: Asian Slaw with Peanut-Lime Dressing and Grilled Chicken
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Whisk the peanut butter, lime, soy sauce and ginger.
Toss with the slaw, edamame and cilantro and top with chicken.

name: Roasted Carrot and Arugula Salad with Goat Cheese
steps: Roast the carrots with half the oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Toss with arugula, balsamic and the rest of the oil and top with goat cheese and walnuts.

name: Mexican Chopped Salad with Lime Dressing
steps: Chop and combine everything.
Dress with lime and oil.

name: Italian Sausage and Kale Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and top with parmesan.

name: Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with the basil.

name: Cabbage and Bean Soup with Smoked Turkey
steps: Soften the onion and carrot, add the cabbage.
Add the broth, beans, turkey and thyme and simmer 25 minutes.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Soup
steps: Soften the onion with the spices.
Add the sweet potato, beans and broth and simmer 22 minutes.
Finish with lime.

name: Creamy Chicken and Wild Rice Casserole
steps: Combine the cooked rice, chicken, mushrooms, onion, thyme and milk in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Turkey Burgers Stuffed with Spinach and Feta
steps: Wilt the spinach and mix with feta and garlic.
Form patties around the filling.
Grill 6 to 7 minutes a side and serve in lettuce.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potato and Broccoli
steps: Toss everything on a tray with oil and spices.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.

name: Lemon Dill Chicken Meatballs with Orzo-Style Quinoa
steps: Mix the chicken, egg, dill, half the lemon, garlic and oat bran and shape meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
Fold the spinach and rest of the lemon into warm quinoa and serve.

name: Garlic Herb Pork Loin Roast with Carrots
steps: Rub the pork with garlic, herbs, mustard and oil.
Roast on the carrots at 400°F for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: Beef and Mushroom Skillet with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and mushrooms; thicken the broth with arrowroot.
Boil and mash the cauliflower with butter.
Serve the beef over the mash.

name: Whole Wheat Penne with Roasted Vegetables and Ricotta
ing: Whole wheat pasta, cooked al dente
steps: Roast the vegetables with oil and garlic at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Toss with the vegetables, ricotta and basil.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Broccoli
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Warm the garlic and pepper flakes in oil.
Toss together with parmesan and parsley.

name: Chickpea Pasta with Pesto, Tomatoes and Chicken
steps: Cook the chickpea pasta and grill the sliced chicken.
Toss with the pesto, tomatoes and spinach.
Top with parmesan.

name: Lentil Pasta with Turkey Bolognese
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion, carrot and garlic.
Simmer with the marinara and seasoning 20 minutes.
Serve over the cooked lentil pasta with parmesan.

name: Fettuccine with Mushroom Cream Sauce
steps: Brown the mushrooms in oil with garlic and thyme.
Add the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss with the cooked pasta.

name: Pasta Puttanesca with Tuna
steps: Melt the anchovy and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, olives, capers and pepper flakes and simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in the tuna and the cooked pasta.

name: Baked Penne with Spinach, Ricotta and Marinara
steps: Cook the pasta slightly firm and mix with the wilted spinach, ricotta, garlic and marinara.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Cacio e Pepe-Style Pasta with Peas
steps: Cook the pasta, saving a cup of its water.
Toss with butter, pepper, parmesan and a splash of the water until creamy.
Fold in the warm peas.

name: Sausage and Peppers Penne
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the onion, peppers and garlic, then the marinara, and simmer 12 minutes.
Toss with the cooked penne.

name: Shrimp and Asparagus Pasta in Lemon Butter
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the asparagus for the last 2 minutes.
Sauté the garlic in butter and cook the shrimp 3 minutes.
Toss with lemon and parsley.

name: Chicken Alfredo-Style Zucchini Noodle Bowls
steps: Sear and slice the chicken.
Simmer the garlic, cream and parmesan.
Toss the zucchini noodles briefly in the sauce and top with chicken.

name: Whole Wheat Spaghetti with Lentil Marinara
ing: Whole wheat pasta, cooked al dente
steps: Simmer the cooked lentils in the marinara with the onion and garlic.
Serve over the pasta with basil.

name: Macaroni Salad with Peas and Yogurt Dressing
steps: Cook and cool the macaroni.
Whisk the yogurt, mayo, mustard and vinegar.
Fold everything together and chill.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad with Olives and Lemon
steps: Cook and cool the pasta.
Toss with the tuna, olives, tomatoes, cucumber, lemon, oil and parsley.

name: Farro Risotto-Style with Mushrooms and Parmesan
steps: Soften the onion and mushrooms in oil with garlic.
Add the farro and wine, then ladle in the broth as it absorbs.
Finish with parmesan.

name: Barley Mushroom Soup with Thyme
steps: Soften the vegetables and garlic.
Add the barley, broth and thyme and simmer 35 minutes.

name: Quinoa Stuffed Acorn-Style Squash with Cranberries
steps: Roast the halved squash.
Mix the quinoa with sautéed onion, cranberries, pecans and sage.
Fill the squash and bake 10 minutes.

name: Brown Rice and Black Bean Burritos in a Bowl
steps: Warm the rice, beans and corn.
Build bowls and top with salsa, avocado, cilantro and lime.

name: Shrimp and Grits with Andouille-Style Chicken Sausage
steps: Cook the grits with the cheddar.
Brown the sausage, pepper and onion, then the seasoned shrimp.
Spoon over the grits.

name: Creamy Polenta-Style Grits with Mushrooms and Spinach
steps: Cook the grits and stir in the parmesan.
Brown the mushrooms with garlic, wilt the spinach.
Spoon over the grits.

name: Baked Eggs in Marinara over Grits
steps: Spoon the grits into ramekins and top with marinara.
Crack in an egg each and bake at 375°F for 12 minutes.
Finish with parmesan and basil.

name: Egg Noodle Chicken Paprikash
steps: Brown the chicken and soften the onion and pepper with the paprika.
Add the broth and paste and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt and serve over the noodles.

name: Garlic Shrimp Zucchini Noodle Scampi Bowls
steps: Sauté the garlic in oil and cook the shrimp 3 minutes.
Toss with the zucchini noodles, lemon and pepper flakes.
Top with parmesan.

name: Turkey Meatball Soup with Tiny Pasta and Spinach
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan and garlic and roll tiny meatballs.
Simmer in the broth with the carrot 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and spinach and cook until the pasta is tender.

name: Date and Walnut Energy Bars
steps: Process the dates, walnuts, oats, almond butter, cinnamon and chia until sticky.
Press into a lined pan and chill; cut into ten bars.

name: Protein Granola Bars with Peanut Butter
steps: Mix the peanut butter, egg white, sweetener and vanilla; fold in the oats, protein and chips.
Press into a lined pan.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes and cut into twelve bars.

name: Trail Mix with Nuts, Seeds and Dark Chocolate
steps: Combine everything in a jar.

name: Baked Cinnamon Pear Chips
steps: Slice the pears thin and dust with cinnamon.
Bake at 225°F for 80 to 90 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Fruit Dip with Apple Slices
steps: Whisk the yogurt, peanut butter, cinnamon and vanilla.
Serve with the apple slices.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend the banana, yogurt, peanut butter and milk thick.
Top with oats and strawberries.

name: Berry Chia Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend the berries, yogurt and almond milk thick.
Top with chia, almonds and coconut.

name: Blueberry Oat Breakfast Bars
steps: Mix the oats, eggs, milk, cinnamon and baking powder; fold in the berries and walnuts.
Bake in a pan at 350°F for 25 minutes and cut into bars.

name: Cottage Cheese Berry Breakfast Bowl
steps: Top the cottage cheese with berries, almonds and chia and dust with cinnamon.

name: Spiced Pumpkin Breakfast Cookies
steps: Mix everything.
Scoop twelve cookies.
Bake at 350°F for 14 minutes.

name: Black Bean Burger on a Whole Bun
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg and spices and form four patties.
Pan-fry 5 minutes a side.
Build on toasted buns with tomato, lettuce and avocado.

name: Mushroom Swiss Turkey Burger
steps: Shape the turkey into four patties and grill 6 minutes a side.
Sauté the mushrooms, onion and garlic.
Top with Swiss and mushrooms on toasted buns.

name: Pesto Veggie Tortilla Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas, spread with pesto and top with the vegetables and mozzarella.
Bake at 425°F for 8 minutes.

name: Cauliflower-Crust Flatbread with Tomato, Mozzarella and Basil
steps: Steam, squeeze and mix the cauliflower rice with the egg, parmesan and seasoning; press into a crust and bake 15 minutes at 425°F.
Top with marinara and mozzarella and bake 10 minutes more.
Finish with basil.

name: Ham and Pineapple Tortilla Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas and top with marinara, mozzarella, ham and pineapple.
Bake at 425°F for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: Chicken Salad Pita with Apple Crunch
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with diced apple, celery, yogurt and mustard.
Stuff into the pitas.

name: Salmon Burger on a Bun with Dill Yogurt
steps: Chop the salmon and mix with egg, oat bran, mustard and half the dill; form patties.
Pan-sear 4 minutes a side.
Serve on buns with dill-spiked yogurt and lettuce.

name: Chili Cheese Dog with Turkey Sausage
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Simmer the beans with the sauce, chili powder and onion.
Grill the sausages and serve in buns topped with chili and cheddar.

name: Banh Mi-Style Chicken Sandwich on a Bun
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Quick-pickle the carrot and daikon in lime.
Build on buns with mayo, cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

name: Falafel Burger Bowls with Tahini
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, parsley, oat flour, garlic and cumin and form patties; bake 15 minutes at 425°F.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and water.
Serve over the salad vegetables.

name: Stuffed Zucchini with Quinoa and Feta
steps: Scoop the halved zucchini.
Mix the quinoa with the chopped flesh, tomatoes, onion, oregano and feta.
Fill and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Cheesy Eggplant Parmesan Rounds
steps: Roast the eggplant rounds brushed with oil.
Top each with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 10 minutes more and finish with parmesan and basil.

name: Loaded Sweet Potato Skins with Black Beans
steps: Bake the sweet potato halves and scoop out most of the flesh.
Fill with beans and cheddar and bake 10 minutes.
Top with yogurt, salsa and cilantro.

name: Turkey Bacon-Wrapped Asparagus Bundles
steps: Wrap bundles of asparagus in turkey bacon.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.

name: Salsa Verde Chicken Roll-Ups
steps: Pound the chicken, layer with spinach and cheese, roll and secure.
Sear, then bake in the salsa verde at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Lemon Herb Turkey Cutlets with Green Beans
steps: Pound and season the cutlets and sear in oil, 3 minutes a side.
Steam the green beans.
Finish the cutlets with lemon and herbs.

name: Chicken Thighs with Olives and Tomatoes
steps: Brown the chicken in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, tomatoes, olives, oregano and wine and braise covered 30 minutes.

name: Spice-Rubbed Turkey Tenderloin with Roasted Carrots
steps: Rub the turkey with oil and spices.
Roast on the carrots at 400°F for 35 minutes and rest before slicing.

name: White Bean and Rosemary Dip
steps: Blend the beans with rosemary, garlic, lemon and oil.
Serve with carrot and celery.

name: Everything Bagel Egg Cups
steps: Dollop cream cheese into six muffin cups with the spinach.
Pour in the eggs and sprinkle with seasoning.
Bake at 350°F for 18 minutes.

name: Avocado Breakfast Bowl with Soft Eggs
steps: Soft-boil the eggs.
Arrange avocado, tomatoes and beans in bowls and top with the eggs, lime and cilantro.

name: Turkey Sausage and Spinach Scramble
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Scramble in the eggs and spinach and top with cheddar.

name: Apple Pie Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, cinnamon and vanilla in a jar; chill overnight.
Top with diced apple and walnuts.

name: Sweet Potato Toast with Egg and Avocado
steps: Slice the sweet potato lengthwise and toast until tender.
Top with mashed avocado, a fried egg, chives and pepper flakes.

name: Mushroom and Swiss Omelet
steps: Brown the mushrooms with thyme.
Cook the eggs in butter, fill with mushrooms and Swiss and fold.

name: Chicken Apple Breakfast Sausage Patties
steps: Mix everything and form eight patties.
Pan-fry 4 to 5 minutes a side.

name: Yogurt Pancake Dippers with Berry Sauce
steps: Whisk the yogurt and eggs, fold in the oat flour and baking powder, and cook small pancakes.
Warm the berries into a quick sauce and serve for dipping.

name: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Stew
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth, potatoes and thyme and simmer 30 minutes.

name: Chicken Barley Soup with Leeks
steps: Simmer the chicken, leek, carrot, celery and thyme in the broth 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the barley and cook until tender, about 25 minutes.

name: Spicy Black Bean and Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic with the spices.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 18 minutes; blend half and finish with lime.

name: Egg and Spinach Drop Soup
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer and add the spinach.
Stream in the beaten eggs and parmesan and stir into ribbons.

name: Salmon and Corn Chowder
steps: Soften the onion and add the broth, potatoes and corn; simmer 12 minutes.
Add the milk and the cubed salmon and cook 8 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Moroccan Chickpea and Vegetable Stew
steps: Soften the onion with the spices.
Add the vegetables, tomatoes, chickpeas and broth and simmer 28 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Garlic Herb Chicken Breasts Stuffed with Spinach
steps: Mix the wilted spinach, cream cheese, garlic and parmesan.
Cut a pocket in each breast and fill.
Sear, then bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Mustard Yogurt Salmon with Green Beans
steps: Mix the mustard, yogurt, lemon and garlic and spread on the salmon.
Roast at 400°F with the green beans for 12 to 14 minutes.

name: Cajun Turkey Meatloaf Muffins
steps: Mix everything but the paste and press into a muffin tin.
Top with the paste and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
steps: Sear the sliced steak in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables, garlic and ginger.
Return the beef with soy sauce and serve over rice.

name: Sheet Pan Pork Chops with Apples and Brussels Sprouts
steps: Brush the chops with mustard and set on a tray with the apple and sprouts tossed in oil and thyme.
Roast at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: Mediterranean Baked Cod with Tomatoes and Capers
steps: Set the cod on a tray with the tomatoes, capers, olives and garlic.
Drizzle with oil and oregano and bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye-Style Sirloin with Garlic Butter
steps: Sear the seasoned steak 3 to 4 minutes a side.
Baste with butter, garlic and thyme; rest and slice.
Serve with roasted asparagus.

name: Peppercorn Steak with Mushroom Sauce
steps: Crust the steak in cracked pepper and sear.
Brown the shallot and mushrooms, add broth and cream and reduce.
Spoon over the sliced steak.

name: Flat Iron Steak Fajitas
steps: Marinate and sear the steak; slice.
Sauté the peppers and onion in oil with a little seasoning.
Serve in warm tortillas with avocado and lime.

name: Greek Beef Bowls with Cucumber Tomato Salad
steps: Brown the beef with oregano and garlic.
Toss the cucumber, tomato and onion with lemon.
Build bowls over quinoa with feta.

name: Italian Beef Braciole-Style Roll-Ups
steps: Pound the steak thin and layer with spinach, parmesan, garlic and pine nuts; roll and tie.
Brown, then braise in the marinara 65 minutes.
Slice and serve with basil.

name: Oven-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Herbed Yogurt
steps: Rub the beef with oil, garlic and rosemary and roast at 425°F to medium rare, about 30 minutes.
Stir the yogurt with mustard and chives and serve alongside.

name: Beef and Cauliflower Rice Stuffed Peppers
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and cumin; mix with the cauliflower rice and tomatoes.
Fill the peppers, top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Lean Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Cashews
steps: Toss the sliced steak in arrowroot and sear in oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Combine with soy sauce and cashews.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Pan Sauce and Green Beans
steps: Sear and roast the pork at 400°F for 14 minutes; rest.
Soften the shallot in the pan, add broth, mustard and thyme and reduce; swirl in butter.
Slice the pork and serve with the sauce and steamed beans.

name: Slow Cooker Pork Chili Verde
steps: Combine everything but the cilantro in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 7 hours, shred and finish with cilantro.

name: Ham and Navy Bean Soup
steps: Combine everything in a pot and simmer 55 minutes, mashing some beans.

name: Smothered Pork Chops with Cabbage
steps: Sear the paprika-rubbed chops; set aside.
Soften the onion and cabbage in the pan, add broth thickened with arrowroot and vinegar.
Return the chops and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Garlic Rosemary Lamb Chops with Roasted Eggplant
steps: Rub the chops with garlic, rosemary and oil; sear 3 minutes a side.
Roast the eggplant with oil at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

name: Turkey Bacon Cheeseburger Salad
steps: Cook the beef patties and crumble; crisp the bacon.
Build the salad with lettuce, tomato, pickle, onion and cheddar.
Dress with yogurt stirred with mustard.

name: Cheeseburger Casserole with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Mix with the cauliflower rice, tomatoes, mustard, pickle and egg in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Spicy Pork Sausage and Kale Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth, beans and pepper flakes and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the kale for the last 5.

name: Beef Burrito Skillet with Rice and Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning.
Add the tomatoes, beans, corn and cooked rice and heat through.
Top with cheddar to melt.

name: Pork Souvlaki Rice Bowls
steps: Marinate the pork cubes in lemon, oregano, garlic and oil and grill.
Serve over rice with cucumber, tomato and yogurt.

name: Glazed Meatballs with Pineapple and Peppers
steps: Mix the meats, egg, oat bran and garlic and shape meatballs; bake 18 minutes at 400°F.
Simmer the pineapple, peppers, soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot into a glaze and toss.

name: Mushroom Swiss Burger Bowls
steps: Cook the beef into patties and slice.
Sauté the mushrooms and onion.
Serve over lettuce and tomato with Swiss and mustard.

name: Teriyaki Pork Stir-Fry with Snap Peas
steps: Sear the sliced pork in oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot and serve over rice.

name: Taco Beef and Black Bean Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes.
Brown the beef with the seasoning and beans.
Split the potatoes and fill; top with cheddar, salsa and cilantro.

name: Brats with Peppers and Onions over Cabbage
steps: Brown the sausages in oil.
Add the peppers, onion and cabbage and cook until tender.
Finish with mustard and vinegar.

name: Lamb and Spinach Stew with Chickpeas
steps: Brown the lamb with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, chickpeas and water and simmer 70 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and lemon.

name: Borscht with Beets and White Beans
steps: Simmer the beets, carrot, onion and broth 25 minutes.
Add the cabbage and beans and cook 12 minutes.
Finish with vinegar and serve with yogurt and dill.

name: Hungarian Beef Goulash with Paprika
steps: Brown the beef and soften the onion with the paprika.
Add the pepper, tomatoes and broth and simmer 90 minutes.
Serve with a spoon of yogurt.

name: Chicken Paprikash with Cauliflower
steps: Brown the chicken, soften the onion and pepper with the paprika.
Add the broth and simmer 25 minutes; stir in the yogurt.
Serve over roasted cauliflower.

name: Kielbasa-Style Turkey Sausage with Sauerkraut and Potatoes
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the onion, apple, potatoes and sauerkraut with a splash of water and cook covered 20 minutes.
Serve with mustard.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Roll Soup
ing: Tomato sauce, canned, no sugar added
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the cabbage, sauce and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the cooked rice.

name: Polish Mushroom and Barley Soup
steps: Soften the vegetables, add the barley and broth and simmer 35 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and dill.

name: Pork Schnitzel, Baked with Almond Crumb
steps: Pound the pork thin, dip in egg then almond flour and parmesan and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Shred the cabbage with vinegar for a quick slaw.
Serve with lemon.

name: German-Style Potato Salad with Mustard Vinaigrette
steps: Boil and slice the potatoes.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and oil; toss with the warm potatoes, bacon, onion and chives.

name: Irish-Style Lamb and Vegetable Stew
steps: Brown the lamb, then simmer with the vegetables, thyme and broth 75 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook 15 minutes more.

name: Corned Beef and Cabbage Skillet
steps: Brown the onion and potatoes in butter.
Add the cabbage and a splash of water and cook until tender.
Fold in the sliced meat and mustard.

name: Swedish-Style Turkey Meatballs with Yogurt Gravy
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, oat bran and onion and shape meatballs; bake 18 minutes.
Thicken the broth with arrowroot and stir in the yogurt.
Serve over boiled potatoes.

name: Gravlax-Style Salmon with Dill Yogurt
steps: Serve the salmon on rye with cucumber slices.
Top with yogurt stirred with dill and lemon.

name: Open-Faced Egg and Smoked Salmon Rye Toast
steps: Spread the toast with cream cheese.
Top with soft egg, salmon, capers and dill.

name: Chicken Matzo Ball Soup Without Matzo
steps: Simmer the chicken and vegetables in the broth 30 minutes; shred the chicken.
Mix the egg and almond flour into small dumplings and poach in the broth 12 minutes.
Return the chicken and finish with dill.

name: Shakshuka-Style Eggs in Tomato and Pepper Sauce on Rye
steps: Simmer the onion, pepper, paprika and tomatoes 10 minutes.
Poach the eggs in the sauce.
Serve with rye toast and parsley.

name: Tuna Melt Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hollow the tomatoes.
Mix the tuna with yogurt, celery and mustard and fill.
Top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.

name: Pierogi-Style Cabbage and Potato Bake
steps: Cook the onion and cabbage in butter until soft.
Mash the potatoes with the cottage cheese.
Layer in a dish and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Hearty Lentil and Sausage Stew, German-Style
steps: Brown the sausage with the vegetables.
Add the lentils, broth and bay and simmer 30 minutes.
Finish with vinegar.

name: Creamy Cucumber Dill Salad
steps: Slice the cucumber and toss with the yogurt, dill, onion and vinegar.

name: Beet and Goat Cheese Salad with Walnuts
steps: Slice the cooked beets over the arugula.
Dress with vinegar and oil and top with goat cheese and walnuts.

name: Turkey and Cranberry Wrap with Spinach
steps: Spread the tortillas with cream cheese.
Layer turkey, spinach, apple and cranberries and roll.

name: Steak and Arugula Sandwich with Horseradish Yogurt
steps: Sear and slice the steak.
Spread the toast with yogurt mixed with mustard and pile on steak, arugula and onion.

name: Grilled Eggplant and Mozzarella Sandwich
steps: Grill the sliced eggplant.
Layer on the bread with pesto, mozzarella, tomato and basil and press.

name: Open-Faced Chicken Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread and top with avocado, shredded chicken and a fried egg.

name: Greek Salad Pita Pockets with Chickpeas
steps: Toss the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, feta and olives with lemon and oil.
Stuff the pitas.

name: Crab Salad Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mix the crab with celery, yogurt, lemon, Old Bay and chives.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Egg Salad Wraps with Spinach and Tomato
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs and mix with yogurt and mustard.
Roll in the tortillas with spinach and tomato.

name: Chicken Pesto Caprese Sandwich
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Layer on toasted bread with pesto, mozzarella, tomato and arugula.

name: Loaded Veggie Hummus Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with hummus and layer the vegetables and feta; roll.

name: Barbecue Pulled Turkey Sandwich with Slaw
steps: Poach and shred the turkey and toss in a sauce of paste, vinegar and paprika.
Mix the slaw with the yogurt.
Pile on the buns.

name: Tuna and White Bean Salad Sandwich
steps: Mix the tuna, mashed beans, onion, lemon, oil and parsley.
Spread on the bread.

name: Italian Chicken Sausage Sandwich with Peppers
steps: Grill the sausages.
Sauté the peppers and onion with the marinara.
Serve on toasted buns.

name: Southwest Chicken Salad with Cilantro Lime Yogurt
steps: Season and grill the chicken; slice.
Arrange the vegetables and beans.
Blend the yogurt, lime and cilantro for a dressing.

name: Salmon Salad with Dill and Cucumber
steps: Flake the salmon and mix with the yogurt, dill, lemon and onion.
Serve over greens and cucumber.

name: Grilled Peach and Arugula Salad with Feta
steps: Grill the peach halves.
Toss the arugula with balsamic and oil and top with peach, feta and pecans.

name: Chopped Greek Chicken Salad with Lemon Oregano Dressing
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Chop the salad vegetables and toss with the lemon, oil and oregano.
Top with chicken, olives and feta.

name: Edamame and Carrot Slaw with Ginger Dressing
steps: Boil the edamame and cool.
Toss with the shredded carrot and cabbage and a dressing of vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce and ginger.

name: Warm Lentil Salad with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Roast the vegetables with half the oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Toss with the warm lentils, arugula, vinegar and remaining oil.

name: Turkey Taco Salad Cups
steps: Brown the turkey with the seasoning.
Fill lettuce cups and top with tomato, cheddar, avocado and salsa.

name: Spinach Salad with Eggs, Mushrooms and Mustard Dressing
steps: Boil and slice the eggs.
Toss the spinach, mushrooms and onion with the mustard, vinegar and oil.
Top with the eggs.

name: Shrimp and Mango Salad with Lime
steps: Poach the shrimp.
Toss the greens, mango, avocado and onion with lime, oil and cilantro and top with shrimp.

name: Quinoa Chickpea Salad with Cucumber and Herbs
steps: Toss everything with the lemon and oil.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Mix the tuna with celery, yogurt, mustard and lemon.
Fill the halved peppers.

name: Chicken Waldorf-Style Salad Cups
steps: Mix the chicken, apple, celery, walnuts, yogurt and lemon.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Protein-Packed Egg White Veggie Scramble
steps: Sauté the vegetables in oil.
Add the egg whites and scramble; top with feta.

name: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal with Pecans
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk, pumpkin and spice.
Top with pecans.

name: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Egg Cups
steps: Fill muffin cups with salmon, avocado and cream cheese.
Pour in the eggs and bake at 350°F for 16 minutes; finish with chives.

name: Whole Grain Toast with Cottage Cheese and Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and top with cottage cheese, tomato, basil and pepper.

name: Turkey Sausage Egg and Cheese Breakfast Bites
steps: Brown and crumble the sausage.
Mix with the eggs, milk, cheddar and spinach and bake in mini muffin cups at 350°F for 18 minutes.

name: Coconut Chia Breakfast Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk the chia, coconut milk, vanilla and sweetener; chill 4 hours.
Top with mango.

name: Banana Almond Butter Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread with almond butter.
Top with banana, chia and cinnamon.

name: Southwest Egg Skillet with Sweet Potato and Black Beans
steps: Soften the diced sweet potato, pepper and onion in oil with cumin.
Add the beans, make wells and cook the eggs in them covered 6 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Apple Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk the eggs and yogurt, fold in the oat flour, protein, cinnamon, baking powder and grated apple.
Cook small pancakes.

name: Spinach and Gruyere-Style Breakfast Strata
steps: Layer the cubed bread, spinach, onion and Swiss in a dish.
Pour over the eggs and milk and bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
steps: Whisk the ricotta, eggs and lemon.
Fold in the oat flour and baking powder; cook small pancakes and top with blueberries.

name: Egg and Black Bean Breakfast Tostadas
steps: Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Top with warm beans, fried eggs, avocado, salsa and cotija.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken with Zucchini Ribbons
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, thyme, garlic and oil; grill.
Sauté the zucchini ribbons briefly and top with parmesan.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Kebabs with Tzatziki
steps: Skewer the marinated chicken with the vegetables and grill.
Serve with yogurt mixed with grated cucumber.

name: Sheet Pan Turkey Sausage with Broccoli and Sweet Potato
steps: Toss everything with oil and garlic powder on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 25 to 28 minutes.

name: Chicken Cutlets with Arugula Tomato Salad
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg then almond flour and parmesan and pan-fry in half the oil.
Toss the arugula and tomatoes with lemon and remaining oil and pile on top.

name: Peanut Chicken Skewers with Cucumber Salad
steps: Marinate the chicken in peanut butter, soy sauce, lime and ginger and grill on skewers.
Toss the cucumber and onion with vinegar.

name: Mediterranean Turkey Burgers with Tzatziki
steps: Mix the turkey with feta, oregano and garlic and shape patties; grill.
Serve on lettuce with tomato and cucumber yogurt.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Soup
steps: Combine everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours and shred the chicken.

name: Turkey and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, sweet potato, beans, tomatoes and broth and simmer 30 minutes.

name: Roasted Garlic Cauliflower Soup
steps: Roast the cauliflower and garlic with the oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Blend with the broth and milk.

name: Spring Vegetable and Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot and leek in the broth 18 minutes; shred the chicken.
Add the asparagus and peas for 5 minutes and finish with dill and lemon.

name: Italian White Bean and Tuna Soup
steps: Soften the garlic in oil, add the broth, beans and tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes.
Fold in the tuna and spinach.

name: Lemon Garlic Baked Tilapia with Roasted Broccoli
steps: Bake the tilapia with garlic butter and lemon at 400°F for 14 minutes.
Roast the broccoli alongside.

name: Salmon and Vegetable Foil Packets
steps: Seal the salmon and vegetables with oil, lemon and dill in foil packets.
Bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Tuna Steak Tacos with Mango Salsa
steps: Sear the tuna 90 seconds a side and slice.
Mix the mango, onion, lime, cilantro and jalapeno.
Serve in warm tortillas.

name: Cajun Catfish Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Season and sear the catfish.
Sauté the pepper and cauliflower rice in oil.
Serve topped with fish, green onion and lemon.

name: Seared Scallops with Lemon Spinach
steps: Sear the dried scallops in butter 2 minutes a side.
Wilt the spinach with garlic and lemon and serve under the scallops.

name: Crispy Baked Shrimp with Cocktail Sauce
steps: Dip the shrimp in egg then almond flour, parmesan and paprika and bake on a tray at 425°F for 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir the paste with lemon for a quick cocktail sauce.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes.
Sauté the chickpeas and spinach with cumin and garlic.
Fill the potatoes and drizzle with lemon tahini.

name: Tofu Veggie Fried Rice, Brown Rice
steps: Brown the tofu, add the vegetables and garlic, scramble in the egg.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Scoop the zucchini and sauté the flesh with the mushrooms, spinach and garlic.
Mix with ricotta, fill the boats, top with parmesan and bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Three-Bean Salad Bowls with Quinoa
steps: Toss the beans, quinoa, onion and pepper with vinegar and oil.
Chill 30 minutes.

name: Roasted Vegetable Frittata Cups
steps: Divide the vegetables among muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and parmesan and bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

name: Black Bean Quinoa Burrito Bowls
steps: Warm the quinoa, beans and corn.
Top with avocado, salsa, lime and cilantro.

name: Baked Chicken Tenders with Mustard Yogurt Dip
steps: Coat the chicken strips in egg then almond flour, parmesan and paprika and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 16 minutes.
Stir the yogurt and mustard for dipping.

name: Mini Turkey Burger Sliders on Lettuce
steps: Shape twelve mini patties and sear 4 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce leaves with tomato, pickle and mustard.

name: Cheesy Chicken and Broccoli Quesadillas
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with chicken, chopped steamed broccoli and cheddar and fold.
Crisp in a pan 2 minutes a side and serve with salsa.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes with cumin.
Warm the beans and tortillas and fill with potato, beans and avocado; finish with lime and cilantro.

name: Pesto Chicken Zucchini Boats
steps: Scoop the zucchini halves.
Fill with shredded chicken mixed with pesto and tomatoes, top with mozzarella and bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Garlic Shrimp Tacos with Avocado Crema
steps: Sear the garlicky shrimp in oil.
Blend the avocado, yogurt and lime into a crema.
Fill the tortillas with shrimp, cabbage and crema.

name: Greek Chicken and Rice Skillet with Spinach and Feta
steps: Brown the chicken and garlic.
Add the cooked rice, broth, oregano and lemon and heat 8 minutes.
Fold in the spinach and top with feta.

name: Beef and Broccoli Cauliflower Rice Bowls
steps: Sear the sliced steak and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger; add the cauliflower rice.
Return the steak with soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Italian Stuffed Mushroom Caps with Turkey Sausage
steps: Remove the mushroom stems and chop.
Brown the sausage with the stems and garlic, mix with the cream cheese and parmesan.
Fill the caps and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Chicken Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hollow the tomatoes.
Mix the chicken with yogurt, celery, dill and lemon and fill.

name: Turkey Meatball and Spinach Stuffed Peppers
steps: Mix the turkey, spinach, garlic and parmesan.
Fill the halved peppers and top with marinara.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Cabbage and Ground Turkey Egg Roll Bowls
steps: Brown the turkey with garlic and ginger.
Add the slaw and soy sauce and cook 6 minutes; finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Spaghetti Squash with Turkey Marinara
steps: Roast and shred the squash.
Brown the turkey with the onion and simmer in the marinara.
Serve over the squash with parmesan and basil.

name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Dry the chickpeas and toss with oil and seasoning.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes and toss with parmesan.

name: Egg Muffin Cups with Bell Pepper and Feta
steps: Divide the chopped pepper, spinach and feta among greased cups.
Pour in the eggs and bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Tomato and Mozzarella Omelet with Basil
steps: Cook the beaten eggs in oil.
Fill with tomato, mozzarella and basil and fold.

name: Sausage, Egg and Cheese Roll-Ups on Tortillas
steps: Scramble the eggs with the crumbled sausage.
Fill the tortillas with the egg mix and cheddar and roll; serve with salsa.

name: Hearty Minestrone with Italian Sausage
steps: Brown the sausage with the vegetables.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.

name: Lemon Chicken Orzo-Style Soup with Spinach
steps: Simmer the chicken and carrot in the broth 15 minutes; shred.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, then the spinach, lemon and dill.

name: Southwest Egg Roll Skillet with Ground Chicken
steps: Brown the chicken with the spices.
Add the slaw, beans and corn and cook 7 minutes.
Top with cheddar and lime.

name: Almond Butter Banana Oat Muffins
steps: Mash the banana and mix with the almond butter, eggs and milk.
Fold in the oats, baking powder and cinnamon.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 minutes.

name: Bell Pepper and Ground Turkey Taco Boats
steps: Brown the turkey with the seasoning.
Fill the pepper halves, top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
Serve with salsa and avocado.

name: Chilled Cucumber Yogurt Soup with Dill
steps: Blend the cucumber, yogurt, garlic, dill, lemon and oil until smooth.
Chill and serve topped with walnuts.
